**_Join our Virtual Phonebank to Get Out The Vote for AZ Climate Champions_**
* * *
We recently endorsed the entire Salt River Project (SRP) Clean Energy slate, a group of candidates who are committed to leading the way to a carbon-free future for the communities they are running to serve. The SRP is the largest public utility in the country in terms of raw power generation, and the election for its key leadership positions is just around the corner on April 2. Unfortunately, the SRP elections are uniquely restrictive and archaic when it comes to determining who is allowed to vote. In short, only SRP ratepayers and landowners are eligible to vote for some of the most important leadership positions in the SRP, and _the impact of a person's vote goes up the more acres they own._ As a result, this election typically sees extremely low turnout, which gives the fossil fuel industry and those who benefit from business as usual a huge advantage in this election. _**That's where you come in! **_ _**Please join us this coming Tuesday, March 26 at 6pm PT. Here’s the reality of the situation: Mitch McConnell handpicked my hedge fund executive opponent because she can self-fund. **She even wrote a $500,000 check to her campaign to kick things off.**
This is a strategy National Republicans are leaning on in key Senate races this year because they think these self-funded campaigns will run themselves. We need to show them their line of thinking couldn’t be further from the truth.
My opponent has avoided interviews and taking a stance on the issues that matter most to New Mexicans. She thinks she can just stay silent and coast to victory.
But _everything is on the line this year_ — from protecting our reproductive freedoms to cutting costs to delivering on sensible gun reform.
New Mexico deserves leaders who are ready to get to work and act like our democracy, our rights, and our climate depend on it — because they do.
**I refuse to stay silent on the issues that matter. If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Despite high disapproval for President Joe Biden in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi, Democrats outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.
We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri.
That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — _except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there._
Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party.
**[I’m proud to support Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley and I hope you’ll join me by adding a donation of $10 or whatever you’re able to today. Folks – this is an honest email about campaign resources and fundraising. I hope you’ll read it:
The most important fundraising deadline yet of the 2024 election cycle is coming up. It’s the first FEC filing deadline of the year, the first deadline since Trump became the presumptive GOP nominee for president, and the first deadline since the general election ballot in my own race was finalized.
Together, all of that means it’s critical for us to put up a strong showing when we file our next fundraising report .
In January, my anti-abortion MAGA opponent announced he’d raised more than half a million dollars in his effort to defeat me – and earlier this month, he solidified his place on the ballot for the general election. So it’s never been more important for us to boost our own efforts.
Between now and midnight on March 31st, I’m pushing to raise another $10,000 online to support this work.
Will you pitch in $25 or more right now to help get there? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=25]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=250]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
I know you get a lot of emails from political candidates and organizations asking for your support, especially around these deadlines. And look, not all of those emails are totally honest. (I’ve never liked to pretend the sky is falling, or like my dog wrote a fundraising email.) But the underlying reason you’re getting these requests is very real.
Fundraising deadlines matter, and public reporting of our numbers matters – all of it shapes the race in the lead-up to November. And the closer we get, the higher the stakes.
So here’s the deal: My team has made it clear that this $10,000 online fundraising goal is important, and that I need to do what I can to get us there. But I’ll be transparent with you about our progress, and once we get there, that’s it – I’m not going to keep emailing you at all hours leading up to the deadline just to get a few more dollars in the door.
Deal?
If you can spare it, please consider making a donation today to support my re-election campaign and help me fight back against attacks from my MAGA opponent. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you for your support! I appreciate you.
-Sara

But I’ll be transparent with you about our progress, and once we get there, that’s it – I’m not going to keep emailing you at all hours leading up to the deadline just to get a few more dollars in the door. I am thrilled to announce my candidacy for Arizona Senate Legislative District 28! In today's political climate, representation at the legislative level in Arizona is at an all-time low. It has become painfully clear during the last legislative session that our elected officials are more focused on their own performance than on addressing the true issues that have a significant impact on our daily lives. As a dedicated public servant for the past 23 years, I have witnessed the growing divide between the constituents and our public office holders. It is time to bridge that gap and restore genuine connection between the community and its neighborhoods.
My campaign for Arizona Senate in LD 28 is centered around reestablishing strong community bonds and delivering meaningtul representation and solutions to the challenges we face. If you reside in the northwest valley in LD 28, I kindly ask you to consider signing my online candidate petition. Both Democrats and Independents are eligible to sign, and we are just shy of reaching 500 signatures. Your support will make a significant difference in our efforts to bring positive change to our district. Thank you for your consideration, and together, let's build a better future for Arizona Senate legislative district 28!

body:
Your weekly rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| | [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
| **March 24, 2024**
# **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
### By Heidi Ganahl
---
| Good evening, Colorado's Congressional District 4 is poised for a [political showdown](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as the race to replace outgoing Representative Ken Buck heats up, especially since March 22nd was his last day. Here's what you need to know about this critical special election to replace Buck until the actual election happens in November: With 11 Republican candidates and five Democrats vying for the primary ballot, and one Libertarian candidate for the general election, the field is crowded and competitive.

[Buck's unexpected resignation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), accelerated from his previously announced departure at the end of his term in January 2025, has triggered a special election ordered by Governor Jared Polis. This election, scheduled for June 25, coincides with Colorado's primary elections for House races.

Republican candidates who have declared their interest in being considered for the special election:
* [Ted Harvey](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), former state senator and candidate for the 6th district in 2008
* [Richard Holtorf](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), state representative
* [Greg Lopez](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), former mayor of Parker and candidate for governor in 2018 and 2022
* [Jerry Sonnenberg](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Logan County commissioner and former president pro tempore of the Colorado Senate
* [John Fabbricatore](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), current candidate for the 6th district

[Mike Lynch](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), state representative and former Minority Leader of the Colorado House of Representatives, still appears to be undecided. Deborah Flora, radio host and candidate for U.S. Senate in 2022, originally stated she was ["all in" for the special election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) but has since [changed her stance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), withdrawing her name from consideration. U.S. Rep [Lauren Bobert](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) has declined her participation in the special election to focus on her primary race. The Republican candidates on the primary ballot for the November election include Lauren Boebert, Mariel Bailey, Deborah Flora, Richard Holtorf, Trent Leisy, Michael Lynch, Chris Phelen, Justin Schreiber, Jerry Sonnenberg, Floyd Trujillo, and Peter Yu.

Colorado's 4th Congressional District encompasses most of the rural eastern half of Colorado, Douglas County, and the city of Loveland, historically leaning Republican since 1973. Special conventions will be held by each party to select nominees for the special election, with the Democrats convening by April 1 and Republicans convening on March 28 in Hugo, Colorado. This special election poses unique challenges and opportunities, potentially affecting the balance of power in the U.S. House of Representatives. As the race unfolds, stay tuned for updates and analysis from Rocky Mountain Voice to keep you informed about this pivotal moment in Colorado politics. Have a great week, Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# FEATURED
---
[**Libertarian Party notes growth in relevancy, influence as state convention opens**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
The relevancy of the Colorado Libertarian Party has advanced in the past year in several measurable ways, State Chairwoman Hannah Goodman said as she opened the party’s annual state convention in Colorado Springs on Saturday. One of those measurements have been increased media exposure, she said, including on local TV programming. “We have had more press exposure than in a long time,” she said. “There’s no secret we have all been held hostage by the Democratic majority. What we sought to do is pressure both [major] parties to run solid liberty candidates.” The intent, Goodman says, is to be a disruptor and run stonger candidates which could pull greater percentages of votes in general elections. “We have become incredibly relevant,” Goodman said. “I’m really proud to try and disrupt things.” [**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
# STATE
**[‘Assault weapons’ bill, opposed by hundreds in marathon hearing, advances in House](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Hundreds of Coloradans provided a master’s course to lawmakers on the Founding Fathers, the Federalist Papers and the U.S. Constitution Tuesday in opposition to House Bill 1292, but it was to no avail.
[**Colorado environmental groups file three ballot measures to limit oil and gas industry**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The truce is off. Let the negotiations begin again. Leading Colorado environmental groups filed language Thursday for three sweeping ballot measures aimed at limiting the oil and gas industry in the state, openly declaring them a blocking effort to as many as a half-dozen equally sweeping proposals supported by oil interests.
[**Colorado is at odds with the feds over prescription drug importation, documents show**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado’s attempts to import lower-priced prescription drugs from Canada appear to have hit a significant roadblock, according to state documents. [**READ MORE STATE NEWS**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
# NATIONAL
**[Congress Unveils $1.2 Trillion Plan to Avert Shutdown](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEWSMAX](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Lawmakers introduced a $1.2 trillion spending package Thursday that sets the stage for avoiding a partial government shutdown for several key federal agencies this weekend and allows Congress, nearly six months into the budget year, to complete its work in funding the government through September.
**[Poll shows who Republicans want as Trump’s VP running mate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**The Center Square Voter’s Voice poll released this week asked voters this question: “Who should Donald Trump choose as his vice presidential candidate?”
**[Federal Court Rules Firearm Restrictions on Defendants Awaiting Trial Are Constitutional](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE EPOCH TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A federal court has ruled it is constitutional to block a defendant’s 2nd Amendment rights while they are awaiting trial. On March 18, the three-judge panel in the U.S. 9th Circuit Court of Appeals unanimously ruled that the restriction on the rights of Jesus Perez-Garcia and John Thomas Fencl to bear firearms is constitutional because it is consistent with historic legal precedent. [**READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
# LOCAL
**[Plea deal gives former producer at Sounds True lenient sentence for possession of 6,000 images of sexual child abuse](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE, BOULDER COUNTY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Mitchell Clute, 57, a former senior producer and editor at Sounds True, has agreed to a plea deal, according to various media reports, on charges of possessing and distributing child sexual abuse material.
**[Fentanyl found on chartered bus Colorado 4th-grade students were on](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS 11 KKTV, SOUTHERN COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**A Colorado school district is sharing a statement after fentanyl was found on a charter bus that was carrying elementary-aged students.
**[Douglas County aims to challenge Colorado’s sanctuary laws amid illegal immigration surge in Denver](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS, DOUGLAS COUNTY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Douglas County’s commissioners are eyeing a legal challenge to Colorado’s “sanctuary” laws amid a surge in illegal immigration that has already cost Denver — the epicenter of the crisis — tens of millions of dollars. **[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
# COMMENTARY
**[Overbeck: Democrats in Colorado Legislature push bills endangering your children](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [JOY OVERBECK, RMV COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Most of us want to see the most vicious child predators and the monsters who use children for sex locked in the slammer for a good, long time. But, not the Democrats in the Colorado Legislature.
**[Open letter to the sponsors of SB24-091, and members of the Joint Technology Committee](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CORY GAINES, RMV COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**My name is Cory Gaines and I’m a resident of Logan County, Colo. I am one of a very few lucky people to live in a town where I can get broadband internet, but I know many in locations similar to mine are not so fortunate. [**READ MORE COMMENTARY**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming a RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)) or send us a message on social media to chat!
# 🏔️ DID YOU KNOW?

On March 24, 1855, the Colorado territorial government officially recognized the **first municipality in the state, Santa Fe.** It was established as a trading post and became a vital center for commerce and transportation in Colorado.

We see the evidence of a changing climate before our very eyes, and we know the impact it could have on our future. But despite all this, Republicans have consistently fought to make it _easier_ to access **dangerous guns** and stood in the way of common-sense gun safety laws that could keep young people safe in school. ## Russia Attackers in Custody, Boy Hailed as Hero
Three of the four suspects charged with killing over 130 Russians in a deadly concert hall attack on Friday [pleaded guilty in a Moscow court](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAYAJ_G3ojg4y8eGLpkS9eOFj8fNg2GCEiivn2Vzh1Pt5zu67pebcqpbJ_2QDNiXa0f6YkrJyAJiFXMwUREQD6jYZoxrrlifN6NokyCPmtmnRZOOVRULkFFFimjkYU5GaAgKAdJF6mkONFAmRBKgJISwdpJUAxp1Hb6rqmMHWP-qU9sJ1-POZt9jHuf-McElwku9l7w1d_qDW0kn3GCS3v0niw5avf1RW7N9lK32vqNbI9yYCG-Fo9tkN3mTGJqSJxmi3cIOoACqhcpYxDAHUMeglfnuZlwf6WcU1d6EnQ7bMp_TePfQ78BAAD__1sBZoA) Sunday. Russia has said it has taken 11 men into custody. The prisoners, all from Tajikistan, came in heavily bruised and cut up, and one arrived in a wheelchair in a hospital gown. Reports said one prisoner had his ear cut off during interrogation, but AP said that hadn't been confirmed. The attack by Islamic State terrorists on Friday night involved at least five men in camouflage firing automatic weapons into the crowd, followed by explosions, fire, and a partial roof collapse. Russians hailed one teenage boy as a hero for saving 100 lives that night. Islam Khalilov, 15, a concert hall cloakroom attendant, shouted at concertgoers to corral them toward an emergency exit. [You can see the video here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1ugzAURp_GbBfZ1z-EgaEZ2NK1I3LwJbgxNjIuVt6-SudO3_BJR0fn6zbdrA8-Pj7tRkNZ0mTn4k-aJKAGVJNq3LAQIcmGBtEJITtphGzWwWirbW91J--qXy76wqUSeDH9vXfmrvrGD8hRcYma99po1XLHhVJGodGa0FqmODlfUm6_k49lpSW80km5ndPWhGEtZT-Y_GA4Mhxrre12xPfHcKQIPwfDMVJ9T005OIbjSjlBIYpw2JMOeNNAcA47pT0Q-AiOrAsv2NIxpwqFck4ZbCl2fsLpHSWGo81wvYpnfsWlyYPbqw_BH6Zjij8268OfYPk3128AAAD__2vTa90)
## March Madness Heads to Sweet 16 Showdown
After four days of furious college basketball, the original 68 schools that started last week's NCAA March Madness tournament are now down to 16 teams battling for the national championship over the next two weekends. On the men's side, Saturday's 86-73 victory by Creighton over Oregon in a [double-overtime thriller](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAQQL_G7ohgGLApKK5Jl2uvtMYwtjlhiDBKtH-_ytZbPr3m6f17LA9KOZX9L53s-1YXCj29eNECjABccIx-YwbWI3s1KaUnbZUeD0-bdG62YV4hyEguMJuApCYkC8a6MXmQgFKDkc5YgzcZpUK0CNYYBqIBJcfUa7v9r6n0g7f8VV_cbqGeY_ZH789r0H8GuA9wp2fh9_VRH2g9hcwD3GvjvRYRGqf96LWIEojESS0c4qRY-LoEBLet6CDOpDVKBQTR6EmtdrYzr-vYfHy-U87pstOAcj8p5Z-I_uuS7wAAAP__jCdgww) stood out. Creighton joins 15 other teams in the Sweet 16 round starting next Thursday. [Here's that lineup of games.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDHP4yAMhn8N2YjAGGiGDLdk6603Rm5wGk5JqIA26r8_cfO32JYe69Wj9899vlPc4_n8TQePdU0zLTV-eDYSrAScsQvjygxsOh6119p447TpttEF1OY2-MGhNQrNSqwe6ragtd5p4C6OoACVAasG6yz2KiiN6BCctQxEAhWHWFPu_6Z41o3X_Zs-nPslHd0-brW-ijC_BEwCpuu6-nehmgJ924OAqdSUv22_Uq5FwHQuRA8BU03vfHJDzUDApEy72zgoL5s8KJxcimxYlou5Su1koMpF7mmhGtPZAr1RZvCISnkBU5fH8LrivsfivED1PCju_2Xrj9X9CwAA___L8mrL) The women's Round of 32 continues today, with few upsets so far. [Caitlin Clark led Iowa](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2vozAQAH8NdI7s9QekoLiGLtdeiRZ7HfZibIStoPz70z298jXTTDOaP4_lgZw4P3_jTlOLZUHf-E2LFmAFmMX0YYpEQLqnSQ1K6UE7pfttkmYcBj1ClN6BdKS8GuLqlBtdUKv1PU8gwUgNVt6ts-Ymg1TGOAPOWgLEzkgK3Mp5-1s4t41i-pQ3nTdf9j5NW2tH7fSvDuYOZjwyXfW_6mCuRzlb7WDOHlFcZadcReA3Vy5ZsFixvqitmJLwG-4Hl1w3PkQuZ9uEx7Mkzii4XN_Y8HrRh6rwyC1xFj7h-RKDV6gcUHSkwdlA4a79PUYYiaw3uj-ncFycElc3dEY-d-T0ld9-nPkvAAD__96Udy0) to a 91-65 victory over Holy Cross, finishing with 27 points and ten assists. The women's Sweet 16 tournament starts next Friday.

On Monday, Baldwin reaffirmed her support for a permanent ceasefire in Gaza, in exchange for the release for all Israeli hostages. Despite the fact that Hamas has openly admitted that they [don't know which hostages are dead or alive, ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-pdkjddk-didthutlhu-t/)Baldwin continues to support the demands set by the terrorist organization. Moreover, Baldwin's agreement to a ceasefire on Hamas' demands ensures that the terror cell will [stay in power](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-pdkjddk-didthutlhu-i/) following the resolution. Matt Fisher, RPW spokesperson, says it best: "Let's not sugarcoat it. Tammy Baldwin just said that Israel and the United States should cave to Hamas' demands."

Our representatives have been working hard to protect our elections, and now it's time to hear your voices! [](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-pdkjddk-didthutlhu-d/) This upcoming, Saturday March 30 is our FINAL Day of Action before the April 2 election. We need all hands on deck to turn out Republicans across Wisconsin to vote for President Donald J. Trump, conservative candidates at the municipal-level statewide, and for the two constitutional amendments on the ballot. [JOIN THE TEAM](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-pdkjddk-didthutlhu-h/) The latest Emerson College Polling Survey found that Baldwin is just [3 points ahead ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-pdkjddk-didthutlhu-k/)of Republican Senate-hopeful Eric Hovde. Over [35 percent](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-pdkjddk-didthutlhu-u/) of Wisconsinites stated that the economy was their most important issue going into the 2025 Senatorial election.

"On Joe Biden's watch, Wisconsin has lost 6,000 manufacturing jobs and 455 dairy farms in the last year. Instead of paying us a visit to brag about his abysmal record, the President should be offering working families an apology for Bidenomics." --WisGOP Chairman Brian Schimming
**[Biden Fails the Hur Test](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-pdkjddk-didthutlhu-s/) **
Special Counsel Robert K. Hur's testimony before Congress and the release of Biden interview transcripts have confirmed both the alarming deterioration of the Democratic nominee's mental acuity and the brazen illegality of the President's handling of classified materials.
**[WisGOP Statement on the State of the Union Address](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-pdkjddk-didthutlhu-g/) **
"No matter how rosy a picture he may try to paint of his job performance, nothing Joe Biden says will change the harsh realities facing Americans of open borders, higher prices, and a weaker economy for working Wisconsinites." --WisGOP Spokesperson Matt Fisher

As we gear up for our biggest deadline yet, I need to lay out what's really on the ballot this November--our future.
Chris Pappas claims to represent New Hampshire, but his actions have told a different story.
Instead of championing Granite Staters, he's become a puppet for Joe Biden and the radical Democrats, rubber-stamping harmful legislation that's left us grappling with the consequences.

# Campaign Update
---
This week's Monday Memo comes from Nathan Freed, the Campaign Chief of Staff....
Dear Peter,,
Here is a quick update from the campaign trail. With just 60 days before the start of early voting for the Primary, there are lots of things happening. Here's a rundown on some of them:
* Mark travels all over our district, participating in several events almost daily. * Volunteers host meet-and-greets in their homes, inviting their family, friends, and neighbors to meet Mark. * [With this link](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_ZLbseQiifcqQLNdfUc5aKwXtQVi7Hm7QJ8i6pu6oAJ5JYrGo2_3Mam1SbaKUej5TLb9ZLrU5cgtuUC9PM4Q_5B7GZuRFeKIyqYVRLRs-ecH9yZXYlGmW-K-783wGGIE_-zWDWzbte1zRKBh5v6C4yx9Rqevkxg97K2XnRTMQ3hQaITolctynLKD6rBh3ctK9QThkxVBhrU=&c=TEY7Hy8h2yRGAsGHFyLCOdkBiIhQROw9v7jlv2lsfszdA8wgNcyqlw==&ch=gzMNnkc_nDYfB9xDfn1-38PsCvX24CKxglfgmQUjMVMSmpdzvH6pZw==), Nevada voters are scheduling personal phone calls with Mark. He has several of these phone conversations each week. * Mark is very visible in the various communities in our district, finding out what issues are most important to them. * We are engaging with the 46,000 registered Republicans who did not vote last time, encouraging them to vote early, in person, or by mail. The message is VOTE! * Our [campaign website](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_ZLbseQiifcqQLNdfUc5aKwXtQVi7Hm7QJ8i6pu6oAJ5JYrGo2_3MUlc5PXvvRojoGBybny8-aZf2bwPvLNnFTl4se1emkNxlZU4H2L6zB1IUOvML3LR6ld89aBGjSNRRZQj4yQariuiExurEz3ugkBZXFW56KnzNXv40_-j5To=&c=TEY7Hy8h2yRGAsGHFyLCOdkBiIhQROw9v7jlv2lsfszdA8wgNcyqlw==&ch=gzMNnkc_nDYfB9xDfn1-38PsCvX24CKxglfgmQUjMVMSmpdzvH6pZw==) has a "Chat" feature people are using to chat directly with Mark (not an A.I. robot). * We're holding events at coffee shops, restaurants, local parks, Senior Centers, and Community Recreation Centers so that Mark can talk with people wherever they gather. * Several Republican Clubs have invited Mark to participate in town halls, debates, and as a keynote speaker. * Local Veteran and law-enforcement organizations are hosting Mark at their events. * We are coordinating our efforts with several Republican candidates running for State and Local offices within our Congressional District, which helps more conservatives get elected. * Local TV, print media, and social influencers have interviewed Mark.
We have hundreds of volunteers, thousands of social media followers, and over 100,000 people who voted for Mark in the last election. Many of these people are involved in knocking on doors, putting out signs, calling voters, sending text messages, and doing other things to help spread the word.
In the last election, Mark beat Titus in Boulder City. He beat her in Henderson. Mark beat Titus by 20 points with in-person voters. Titus won the ballot-harvested and mail-in votes. Like Abraham Lincoln and Ronald Reagan, who also lost their first elections, we are using these lessons to win this time. No one is better positioned to win the general election than Colonel Mark Robertson!
Our momentum is building. You can still get involved if you like. Please respond to this email, and someone from our all-volunteer staff will contact you!
Sincerely,
Nathan Freed

body:
That’s why I’m calling for reinforcements.

| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Speaker Mike Johnson.

_You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists. _

So you can imagine the immediate wrath I faced when I went on record supporting Donald J. Trump for President. I was just talking to my friend, Steve Scalise - he faced the same thing when he endorsed Trump too.

_**[He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we’ve got to stick together.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31135%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=m%2bnW6ayjln7djZEwpANz2A&sysid=1 "He and I agree: as strong
Pro-Trump Conservatives, we’ve got to stick together.")**_

That’s because the anti-Trump Media... Young radicals on college campuses... the holier-than-thou elites in Hollywood... Democrat Super PACs... Joe Biden’s army of megadonors... They are fully committed to destroying our movement and replacing EVERY LAST ONE OF US with a Liberal Democrat.

But wait, that’s not even the half of it. It gets worse:
** Problem #1: ** We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

** Problem #2: ** House Democrats have forty million bucks stashed away to attack pro-Trump Conservatives like us.

** Problem #3: ** Joe Biden just bragged about raising a million bucks in a SINGLE DAY attacking President Trump.
I cannot stress the urgency of the situation enough. Early voting is about to start in the first Special Election AND the Left's fundraising advantage grows by the minute...

_**[So as one of my first moves of the election year, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31136%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FLS%2b%2bpuUP0wWRiHtadglfA&sysid=1 "So as one of my first
moves of the election year, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve
Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of
the month.")**_

I know, I know - that’s a big goal. I get that. But that’s as low as I could possibly make it to fully fund our campaign operations in every must-win swing state.

If we fail to hit it, the consequences would be unthinkable. We’d have no choice but to: **1) ** SCRAP our get-out-the-vote operations, **2) ** SLASH the budget for our ad campaigns, and **3) ** Throw our digital outreach plans IN THE TRASH CAN.

Nothing - and I mean NOTHING - would be worse for our plans to defend our razor-thin House Majority. **That’s why I’m calling for reinforcements.**

_I know the economy is in bad shape under Joe Biden. So if that’s preventing you from pitching in $100 or $50 - I completely understand. But if you can afford JUST $10 or even $5, I would be grateful beyond measure. _

_**[I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31137%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oqZ%2bsBDAP2MlYFOPVe4gHQ&sysid=1 "I only ask everyone
reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.")**_

When the stakes are this high, that’s what will be the difference between saving our Republican Majority and losing to the Trump-hating Democrats. So can I count on you to pitch in SOMETHING?
---
**[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31138%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7auo3YRXl6%2ffCnBNd%2b4ciA&sysid=1)[**YES >>**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31139%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KdRRqzVPoSuE7kbDU2ChgA&sysid=1)_[**NO >>**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31130%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cQO%2fjqIAxgbqgi%2bmq3o%2fVw&sysid=1)**

Thanks for everything you do.

In liberty,
Mike Johnson (Speaker of the House)

On Message
from Michael B. Moore
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Welcome to our campaign newsletter.
We're happy you're here.
We're using this space to keep you updated on all the latest stories, events, and opportunities related to Michael's run for South Carolina's 1st Congressional District.
Stay tuned — we'll be in your inbox every Monday.
See you on the trail.
Join our movement [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
In the news
The Retail, Wholesale and Department Store Union just announced its support for Michael's candidacy — the first major labor endorsement in the race for SC-01!
As a longtime business leader, Michael knows firsthand that employees throughout every organization deserve fair pay, safe working conditions, and comprehensive labor rights.
From the trail
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On Monday, Michael met with community leaders and local Democrats on Hilton Head Island [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/xYgj4TCLJT9qPDwJ/?mibextid=WC7FNe] .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Later that evening, Michael spoke at an event with the Sea Pines Blues [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/xYgj4TCLJT9qPDwJ/?mibextid=WC7FNe] .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On Tuesday, Michael stopped by a meeting of the Forest Hills 1 Civic Association [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/hkvTdUgWnFQ6WahX/?mibextid=WC7FNe] .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On Wednesday, Michael headlined a community event on Daniel Island [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/akReAnLeErq4fKcN/?mibextid=WC7FNe] .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On Saturday, Michael enjoyed some coffee and conversation with the Low Country Liberal Ladies [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/MLCZx5Xawsad8vag/?mibextid=WC7FNe] .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
And on Sunday, Michael attended a Charity Missionary Baptist Church [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/rxPvrpFcmHikGdQ6/?mibextid=WC7FNe] service led by Rev. Nelson B. Rivers.
On our team
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
There's so much work to do, and we're only just getting started.
Join us in our fight to flip this swing district.
Together, we're going to build a brighter future for South Carolina.

| **** Would someone from even just twenty years ago recognize the United States anymore?Our wide-open border, thanks to President Biden, sees terrorists walk onto our soil every day - soil your family died defending - in unthinkable numbers. In just the last couple of weeks, a self-proclaimed Hezbollah trained terrorist crossed into our country with the intent to create a bomb and go to New York.
The mainstream media, of course, is lying to Americans with claims that the only individuals seeking asylum are families. However, as recently as a week ago, Border Patrol has said that it "continues to see a surge in migrants whose names appear on the terror watchlist entering the US illegally as crossings continue at record levels" (New York Post). So, somebody is lying and it's not our Border Patrol.
Meanwhile, Joe Biden is too busy promoting his staff that assisted him in the mishandling of classified documents than to pay attention to the threat to our people. This mishandling should have him prosecuted but instead he gets off without so much as a warning because of his "poor memory".
What would the Founding Fathers have to say about a sitting president knowingly allowing terrorists into the country while promoting corrupted officials and weaponizing government agencies for his own benefit?
**This is why it is more important than ever to Secure & Win. **We cannot, as American citizens, sit by and watch our country burn at the hands of greedy, power-hungry elites who do not want our country to succeed. You are the line of defense between your family and tyranny and it starts at the polls.

If those are your values, I am asking you to join CASA in Action by supporting my campaign with a contribution today.

With Gratitude,
Shamaine

In 2020, Georgia was the closest state in the country. Joe Biden won by just 0.23% of the votes cast. Both Senators Jon Ossoff and Rev. Warnock’s races went to runoffs, and _**both**_ won in January of 2021.

Then, in 2022, we re-elected Rev. Warnock in one of the most challenging races across the country.

And now, one of the most reliable pollsters of Georgia political opinion, the _Atlanta Journal-Constitution,_ is showing a **_one point race._**

clean_body: about what’s happening in GA | | | Peter, as the Executive Director of the Democratic Party of Georgia, I read a whole lot of news and commentary about what’s happening in Georgia and who’s going to win in November. = A lot of the media is trying to portray Georgia as a lock for Donald Trump. body:

Biden and the Democrats hate that I’m a Pro-Trump, black conservative & 8-year army veteran who won’t bow down to their woke agenda. They're dumping piles of dough into my race to make sure my first term in office will be my last. If I don’t turn this campaign on its head right now, we’ll lose this House seat, and Republicans will never pass another law in Congress again. Friend, this is Republican John James. They’ve gone as far as smearing my good name in the Fake News media. Apparently my deployments during Operation Iraqi Freedom weren’t good enough. I’ll be frank - I’m defending the most critical seat in the country in the blue state of Michigan, and if I lose this race, our House majority will crumble. Dems poured $2.5 million into my race in 2022, and I only squeaked out the victory by 1,600 votes. I can guarantee you that 2024 will only be worse. I’m a veteran and businessman, not a polished career politician, so I need your help to stop Biden’s destructive plan for America. I’m shaking the coffers upside down but I’m coming up short. But if I muster up enough support to win, you have my word - I’ll stand up for freedom in Congress every day I serve. body:
>From securing another straw poll win to receiving an 'A' rating from the NRA, the momentum for my campaign continues to build!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

What a week it has been! From securing another straw poll win in Knox County to receiving an 'A' rating from the NRA and being featured in Indiana State Affairs for my dedication to serving Hoosiers, the momentum for our campaign continues to build.

Let's hit the highlights!

** SEEN ON SOCIAL: NRA gives Crouch an 'A' rating (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid0Dc444pnP7xGsMjZRRbahnxYbEU2NZXV4sE7LGQcRRdab5JEeBnmAQd7BwVvbFeusl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

As a gun owner and proud member of the NRA, I️ am honored to have received a perfect rating from the NRA for my steadfast leadership in protecting our Second Amendment rights.
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid0Dc444pnP7xGsMjZRRbahnxYbEU2NZXV4sE7LGQcRRdab5JEeBnmAQd7BwVvbFeusl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** IN THE NEWS: S (https://www.ibj.com/articles/lt-gov-suzanne-crouch-axe-the-tax-to-leave-more-money-in-hoosier-pockets?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) uzanne Crouch positions herself as a 'different' candidate for the voiceless (https://stateaffairs.com/indiana/elections/suzanne-crouch-governor-candidate/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

This article inIndiana State Affairs (https://stateaffairs.com/indiana/elections/suzanne-crouch-governor-candidate/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) highlights my years of service to Hoosiers and how I plan to leverage that experience and the relationships I've built to deliver tangible results for our state.

>From advocating for an independent audit of FSSA to supporting legislation limiting executive powers, I will always prioritize the voices of Hoosiers.

Check out the article below to learn more!
https://stateaffairs.com/indiana/elections/suzanne-crouch-governor-candidate/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
READ THE ARTICLE (https://stateaffairs.com/indiana/elections/suzanne-crouch-governor-candidate/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Celebrating my THIRD Straw Poll Win!
------------------------------------------------------------

It is my immense honor to announce I️ secured my third straw poll win with 70% of the vote in Knox County!

Thank you to the precinct committee men and women who believe in my vision and support me and my campaign.
https://crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** IN THE NEWS: Crouch calls for all Republican governor candidates to be in televised debates (https://stateaffairs.com/indiana/elections/crouch-governor-televised-debates/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

Throughout my years of public service and as a candidate for governor, I have always stood for fairness, transparency, and accountability. The more voices we have in our democratic process, the better.

The gubernatorial campaigns of Jamie Reitenour and Curtis Hill collected thousands of Hoosier signatures and qualified for the May Primary ballot—but these candidates are being denied an opportunity to participate in upcoming televised debates.

I call not only on the organizations sponsoring the debates to include all Republican candidates, but also the campaigns of Mike Braun, Brad Chambers, and Eric Doden to join me in this request as well.

Indiana stands for fairness, not a Washington, D.C.-style insiders club where only certain people are popular enough to get on stage.
https://stateaffairs.com/indiana/elections/crouch-governor-televised-debates/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
READ THE ARTICLE (https://stateaffairs.com/indiana/elections/crouch-governor-televised-debates/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** SEEN ON SOCIAL: Securing Indiana's Water Future (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid036sdCAHJuHypp2Lt9T8BH7fk1MTh1yMj46pSWyXG3Yro9ZKCe3U2WdKuMH63qh9Zul?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

World Water Day underscores the significance of water access. In Indiana, the absence of a statewide water plan is a critical gap.

As governor, I will implement a statewide plan to ensure Hoosiers have access to clean water. We will utilize our natural resources to foster economic growth and not blindside local governments like what happened with the LEAP District Project.
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid036sdCAHJuHypp2Lt9T8BH7fk1MTh1yMj46pSWyXG3Yro9ZKCe3U2WdKuMH63qh9Zul?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** NFIB Gubernatorial Candidate Forum
------------------------------------------------------------

Had a great time sharing my plans to eliminate Indiana’s income tax at last week's NFIB forum hosted by Gerry Dick of Inside INdiana Business!

When we #AxeTheTax (https://crouchforindiana.com/axe-the-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , we'll put an average of $2,000 in Hoosiers' pockets annually, stimulate investment, create jobs, & supercharge Indiana's economy!

** Vanderburgh County Lincoln Day Dinner
------------------------------------------------------------

What a fantastic evening at the Vanderburgh County Lincoln Day Dinner! It's always special to be back home among friends and fellow Republicans.

Thank you to Chairman Mike Duckworth and the entire Vanderburgh County Republican Party for hosting!

** Hoosier Homestead Awards
------------------------------------------------------------

Last Week, I presented the Hoosier Homestead Awards to families that have kept their farm in the family for 100+ years.

These families have fought for generations to protect their land.

As Secretary of Agriculture, I've championed this cause, and as Governor, I'll continue to fight to keep our Hoosier land in the hands of Hoosiers.

** ICYMI: H (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid0Bhxr6vCPNSw9GHThgn7HqjvyHi33uz339LCnoFxbW21RHLeb4beRNJLnaNqiuDnNl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) appy National Agriculture Day! (https://crouchforindiana.com/protect-indiana/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

March 19 marked National Agriculture Day. As Secretary of Agriculture for one of the top agricultural states in the country, I'm honored to lead efforts to protect Indiana land from foreign adversaries (https://crouchforindiana.com/protect-indiana/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) who threaten our land, livelihoods and our state's security.
https://crouchforindiana.com/protect-indiana/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** ICYMI: Endorsements (https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
Suzanne Crouch is the only gubernatorial candidate who has been endorsed by more than 150 past and present elected officials in Indiana. A full list of those endorsements can be found here. (https://crouchforindiana.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db6332b918877c0167cdddb48&id=b5bfcd6fae&e=1a234020cb&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=c7779aac5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_21_03_31&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-c7779aac5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Last but not least...
------------------------------------------------------------
As we celebrate victories and address critical issues like water access and fair debate participation, I am grateful for your ongoing support.

Together, we will keep Indiana strong and prosperous.

Onward and upward,

Let's keep the conversation going! Follow me on social to keep up with the campaign. Have questions, comments or concerns? Send me an email!

I call not only on the organizations sponsoring the debates to include all Republican candidates, but also the campaigns of Mike Braun, Brad Chambers, and Eric Doden to join me in this request as well. Indiana stands for fairness, not a Washington, D.C.-style insiders club where only certain people are popular enough to get on stage. We will utilize our natural resources to foster economic growth and not blindside local governments like what happened with the LEAP District Project. subject: John Avlon

---
|
Hello, I hope that your weekend was good.

Have you ever had a friend tell you that they’re running for office? I had that experience a few weeks ago – my friend John Avlon announced he is running for Congress in New York’s 1st district in Long Island.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=9149f62223&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
If John seems familiar to you, he’s a journalist and author who has been a CNN anchor for years. He also was a guest on my podcast last year to talk about his latest book on Abraham Lincoln – he’s a massive history buff with a deep love of country.

“I talk about the importance of the time that we’re in, that democracy is at stake, and I felt like I shouldn’t just be talking, I should do something about it,” John said when I interviewed him on the podcast this week. “I thought that if I decided to run, I could make a seat competitive that otherwise wouldn’t be in play.”

>From the early returns, he’s right. His announcement video has been watched 2.6 million times and he raised $400,000+ in his first week. “The reaction has been even better than I’d imagined,” John says. The local Democratic party helped enlist John in part because they thought he would inject some energy into the race.

“My opponent is endorsing Trump in a district that is a lot more middle-of-the-road. I’d like to provide a common sense alternative which is what most people seem to want.” John is focused on affordability. “When I talk to families, they are struggling to make ends meet. I want to bring back the child tax credit so families feel like they have a bit of support. I’ve got two young kids myself so I know how hard it can be.” He also wants to help address climate change in an area that has a lot of shoreline.

John is a longtime political reformer in favor of measures like Ranked Choice Voting. “We are rewarding the wrong behavior. I want to improve the incentives so that leaders feel like they can do the right thing without getting singled out or punished. A lot of that is about getting beyond the toxic partisanship that is so dominant right now.” John presented me an award at the Fairvote Gala last year and has been a friend to reform efforts for years. He would make a phenomenal ally in Congress – I can imagine some very smart reform bills getting a lot more energy with John as a co-sponsor.

I’m excited about John’s candidacy in large part because he’s genuine. You know when you see someone on TV and then wonder if they’re actually that sincere and patriotic in real life? Having known John for years, he’s the real thing. He cares. He’s stepping up to run because his country needs people like him to do just that. It’s what you want to see. Let’s help him win.

For my interview of John click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=362169fc9b&e=0f227c2ae3). To support his campaign click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=cd103c1e7b&e=0f227c2ae3). To check out the Forward chapter in your area click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=07ed4d95f0&e=0f227c2ae3).

| Last month marked a momentous milestone on our journey together. It was then that I had the distinct honor of officially submitting my petition, a pivotal step toward securing my place on the ballot. This action isn't just about my name in print; it's a testament to our shared vision for a brighter future. As I stand to serve the dynamic and spirited community of Tennessee, I do so with the hope of becoming the Democratic nominee for the United States Senate. Together, we embark on this journey, not just to win an election, but to rekindle the promise of our great state within the tapestry of this great nation. [This moment brought me back to our inaugural journey in 2020. Whether you've been riding alongside me since those early days, or you're among the many new faces joining our movement daily, I want you to know how much your support means to me. Back in 2020, our victory in the primary was unexpected, yet together, we proved that our progressive movement could defy the odds.](https://l5vsmw.fg98.fdske.com/ec/gAAAAABmAYt17HxgJ20Ff0MVx3ILj2-f0J8B8kJe-vugiZCRAT0K2XzgW16zGDH94kBgtUwnmYAMCK35J3WAglHX07nBUIuSVgzJ6ec0IeMB8bRDqiHRL082q_Md8KhuIiTNQuK6xTeOUcNpW5wczii2HMB9n_XkvqBFeFwNaYxiQwLifuZ7hAqWc0kqKIgQU1H10LIoVl2T7HZmreKDCaurDkp5rPYr6y1NL-9gX1Zjox9Gtq4Fhc46qhyzhY3J1xnUTo5wURkKB-btToRlzxvJ-5SkfqpJw0OieQr1VsJIqBbyXrNTyCrPehrgigTkUKsqWYSOQWFDjQ-mWYGk7eUHNNdVebihOleRSP297HR3Mb5sZ168OqMpSJmEzL1Sx0qllCTqRXbVqaXMgngsqYia8lQ6IKcFoLoG0sHQz_ZMMvffMVAYzRVFxqNP-IRPqQQrH8epixjGYD3QYw6MeyclgAnpw9JTmg==) For more than a quarter of a century, I've dedicated myself to organizing and advocating for our communities, often from behind the scenes. As a single mother, I've navigated the harsh realities of poverty, and even after finding my way out, I was thrust back into financial uncertainty when our healthcare system let me down following a necessary surgery. Yet, here we stand, on the brink of another historic achievement. In 2020, we achieved what many deemed impossible by defeating an establishment candidate who had a war chest of $2 million, with our modest budget of less than $25,000. We are poised to replicate that success. My approach to spending a dollar, shaped by my experiences as a single mom, differs vastly from that of the affluent. This principle underscores why every contribution to our campaign, sourced from the hardworking individuals of our community—my friends, my neighbors, and my family—translates into significant strides forward for us. [We're now expanding this grassroots campaign, gathering the resources necessary to traverse the entirety of Tennessee. Our mission is to engage directly with the people I aim to represent in the U.S. Senate, ensuring they understand my commitment to working on their behalf.](https://l5vsmw.fg98.fdske.com/ec/gAAAAABmAYt1H2S_5nWEpywR4qyhRIP2HyCPBHsWX0_HZD-i8prZPA389kFwslAg2fM2x433gXEM5zcEOe1nQ-ks4EoA94E1BQp88zWdcgNRKt5haFWko4U-L30YAyKfhWGgqdsDqt8XnE4kIGFWEahI-lnLHMlI-ihpRTQ0T4cmL9C2sodQzScv5cX4fZgF1Mp_BFG0wg5pEcloZMDCtWN0GUWYPzfRAHio1rsPyaN2ziBw6lcc_cKR1lMlfEf-NhI6S2mr4yw_rONqQRTfcQBGZM78xsmpwnTJ22fvEtsvm4-FBUCj498G3PWHWhj6oovdjVa9OwaCDpA5BsWkDLZDhm8OSwNwyRN4rViiDEREY95qvOJKEbHBr94u6MRW0s1KhGnJjQVFls6yANia061zappPO8sqa4tlzywHYtwVAjs5vYQZKGZraBc_FxSvTqLFgdFSsFv8Rm0b48NXkaY3Q5CVsKce6w==) I firmly believe that the essence of leadership lies in the ability to listen. Our journey to this point has been fueled by our organizing prowess, and it is this very skill that will guide us to victory once more, enabling us to flip this Senate seat in the general election, and safeguard it from the likes of Marsha Blackburn, Donald Trump, and their deliberate disregard for our values. Today, I extend an invitation to you to join this cause with a contribution—be it $27, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford—to help us turn the page towards an America that truly embodies the spirit of inclusivity. You are an indispensable member of this team, and your continued support is crucial as we navigate the path ahead. clean_body: This is more than just a step towards a ballot spot—it's a leap towards our shared dream. | | | | | | | | | A New Chapter Begins: Join Me on This Journey | Peter | Last month marked a momentous milestone on our journey together. It was then that I had the distinct honor of officially submitting my petition, a pivotal step toward securing my place on the ballot. This action isn't just about my name in print; it's a testament to our shared vision for a brighter future. As I stand to serve the dynamic and spirited community of Tennessee, I do so with the hope of becoming the Democratic nominee for the United States Senate. Together, we embark on this journey, not just to win an election, but to rekindle the promise of our great state within the tapestry of this great nation. == For more than a quarter of a century, I've dedicated myself to organizing and advocating for our communities, often from behind the scenes. As a single mother, I've navigated the harsh realities of poverty, and even after finding my way out, I was thrust back into financial uncertainty when our healthcare system let me down following a necessary surgery. Yet, here we stand, on the brink of another historic achievement. In 2020, we achieved what many deemed impossible by defeating an establishment candidate who had a war chest of $2 million, with our modest budget of less than $25,000. We are poised to replicate that success. My approach to spending a dollar, shaped by my experiences as a single mom, differs vastly from that of the affluent. This principle underscores why every contribution to our campaign, sourced from the hardworking individuals of our community—my friends, my neighbors, and my family—translates into significant strides forward for us. == I firmly believe that the essence of leadership lies in the ability to listen. Our journey to this point has been fueled by our organizing prowess, and it is this very skill that will guide us to victory once more, enabling us to flip this Senate seat in the general election, and safeguard it from the likes of Marsha Blackburn, Donald Trump, and their deliberate disregard for our values. Today, I extend an invitation to you to join this cause with a contribution—be it $27, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford—to help us turn the page towards an America that truly embodies the spirit of inclusivity. You are an indispensable member of this team, and your continued support is crucial as we navigate the path ahead. name: Jon Hamm
subject: Will you help me defeat Josh Hawley this year by joining me in supporting Lucas Kunce and Bob Casey today?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
Hi Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
I’m a born-and-raised Missourian who watched with horror when Josh Hawley raised his fist at insurrectionists outside the U.S. Capitol on January 6th, then ran out the back door when they stormed the building later that day.
I’ve seen communities across my home state torn apart because of cowardly politicians like him — and I’m not willing to sit on the sidelines in this election.
So before I ask you to **[split a donation of $10 or whatever you can today between my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to replace Josh Hawley and Bob Casey](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240325-1?refcode=em20240325-1&expresslane=true&refcode2=2419_552475_gle4NU&akid=2419%2E552475%2Egle4NU)****, please let me tell you why:**
**[Support Lucas Kunce ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240325-1?refcode=em20240325-1&expresslane=true&refcode2=2419_552475_gle4NU&akid=2419%2E552475%2Egle4NU)**
Most of my family is from a town in Missouri called Ste. Genevieve, about 60 miles south of St. Louis. I’ve watched their community go downhill for years.
While corrupt politicians shipped jobs overseas and voted to give handouts to Wall Street and their corporate allies, everyday people just trying to survive in the place they call home ran out of money and opportunities.
**Our leaders abandoned them — and Josh Hawley is the perfect example.**
Instead of fighting for what would make the communities in my home state stronger, Josh Hawley has been busy engaging in the out-of-touch culture wars that only divide us — all so he can get more and more power for himself.
That’s what we saw on January 6th, 2021. Hawley raised his fist at rioters outside the Capitol because he thought it would make himself look strong. But when sh*t got real, he ran out the back door like a coward — away from the same people he was claiming to support just hours earlier.
What’s even more ridiculous? Since that day, Hawley has desperately tried to convince all of us that he’s the authority on what it means to be a man in this country. He even published a whole book about it last year:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240325-1?refcode=em20240325-1&expresslane=true&refcode2=2419_552475_gle4NU&akid=2419%2E552475%2Egle4NU)
Well... when I think about manhood, I think about courage. And that’s not something you can write a book about.
Missouri is the Show Me State. Courage is something you have to show us.
**That’s why I’m supporting Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.** As a born-and-raised Missourian who joined the Marines to serve the community that took care of him growing up, Lucas has already shown us that he knows the true meaning of courage.
Lucas knows courage is about standing up to the powerful and working to rebuild our state. And he knows real leaders fight to empower everyday people and secure our future for generations to come — not for their own power or profit.
**So , if you want to be told about manhood, some guy wrote a book about it.****[But if you want someone to show you real courage, please join me in supporting Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate by splitting a donation of $10 between his campaign and Bob Casey today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240325-1?refcode=em20240325-1&expresslane=true&refcode2=2419_552475_gle4NU&akid=2419%2E552475%2Egle4NU) **
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240325-1?refcode=em20240325-1&refcode2=2419_552475_gle4NU&akid=2419%2E552475%2Egle4NU)**
**Lucas worked hard over the last year to put Missouri’s Senate race on the map.** From calling out Josh Hawley’s blatant corruption to building a coalition of working people, pro-democracy organizations like End Citizens United, and local leaders across Missouri — he is Democrats’ best chance to defeat a GOP incumbent and flip a U.S. Senate seat this election cycle.
He’s building a truly grassroots campaign, without a cent from corporate PACs, to defeat Hawley and take back power for everyday working Missourians — just like my friends and family in Ste. Genevieve.
**It has never been more important to elect a warrior for working people like Lucas Kunce to the U.S. Senate.****[So Peter, will you join me in supporting Lucas Kunce by splitting a donation of $10 between his grassroots campaign and Bob Casey today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240325-1?refcode=em20240325-1&expresslane=true&refcode2=2419_552475_gle4NU&akid=2419%2E552475%2Egle4NU)**
**[Support Lucas Kunce ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240325-1?refcode=em20240325-1&expresslane=true&refcode2=2419_552475_gle4NU&akid=2419%2E552475%2Egle4NU)**
Thanks for standing with me,
Jon Hamm

* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://go.bobcasey.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/?t=1&akid=2419%2E552475%2Egle4NU)

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

You can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=4e7cf7b68c6048e98432b53933f91a8c&_e=SD5oqI7IwgfIqyxVbq7kVi_6_WQ8DXo_AnKREOiaRQabyE4ViRyEqCKj7DhhPSN8pFT152d9S9HZeOHxt9yGusuLAPUVbGfpM-oMV_eFzjFfQAR4tyMR0jtq0iBkwtr6hos-CeDA6F2l2suaeoDrEorGK-N8fzouHsFyQE6lUO_jdci6SufgozeaPuhrNSl4HTqYSNT5eByrE4yT5XcTYky5Fk_nqqcfaXHc3VjaGvjPHKEM76JkF5oqpr1ZyfIYp-fku7hH2z6UX0TzeiPt02_VNW6TPavfYoB-8jFqv-tiAHXfHQlcq25LRjJHQKt8HAt9e74EDdX6KR_SylytRwMb8q-8aLS7Y_SPVRl17ME-2A0hjAKdEd-YMphBYPwu)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education** , including **a required course on the Constitution**
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=4e7cf7b68c6048e98432b53933f91a8c&_e=SD5oqI7IwgfIqyxVbq7kVi_6_WQ8DXo_AnKREOiaRQabyE4ViRyEqCKj7DhhPSN8pFT152d9S9HZeOHxt9yGusuLAPUVbGfpM-oMV_eFzjFfQAR4tyMR0jtq0iBkwtr6hos-CeDA6F2l2suaeoDrEorGK-N8fzouHsFyQE6lUO_jdci6SufgozeaPuhrNSl4HTqYSNT5eByrE4yT5XcTYky5Fk_nqqcfaXHc3VjaGvicJS98d7jVbeyP9md7j9OM550k-iDpGzXLyfPy7pOlNucEeDElEM_cnQLd1pFwojfE8Q4YOCwmAsl0OtgYQxbSHedVIDypWB-8gjq_59yixAQLKsopZlYoPmHVEea09UjEoIAsNU8URcbdAOhy8z7r)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education , including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. Peter, it's Dick Durbin.
It's been a little while since I last reached out, so I'd like to share why it’s an honor to represent you – and if you're willing, ask you to [**chip in any amount to help us keep our Senate majority this November.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81618871/463009911/1907121275?amount=25&source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.03.25_B1_ReIntro_Exp_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTRjY2NhZC1iOWVhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RdxKbpHhnYyva12DvqfGiUMPLkNBXjzXXUGLviZ97zQ=)
The story of my family is one of immigrants seeking the American Dream. My mother, Anna, immigrated from Lithuania and later met my father, William, an Irish-American. It's their determination, faith, and perseverance that inspired me as a kid, and still does to this day.
In high school, I got my first job at a meatpacking plant. I used what money I made to save up for an education. It wasn't easy, **but it taught me that working hard pays dividends, especially when others are counting on you.**
I was first drawn to public service as a college student. Using the determination passed down to me from my parents, I became an intern for the late Senator Paul Douglas (he was one of the greats).
A Bachelor's and Law Degree later, I married my wife, Loretta, and continued my work in government. Shortly after, I ran for and was elected as a member of the House of Representatives _by less than one percent._ Since then, **I've served with a single goal in mind: to fight for Illinois families just like mine.**
Fast forward a few elections and it's now the honor of a lifetime to serve as United States Senator for the state that has helped shape me into who I am today. As your Senator, I've seen fierce debate and remarkable moments of bipartisanship – it epitomizes the greatness of our democracy and who we are as a people. But this year feels different.
Donald Trump and his MAGA agenda continue to resonate across all corners of our country. He's using his platform as a means to uplift election deniers, anti-abortion extremists, and voting rights critics – **and they're running for Senate in 2024.**
It's more important than ever that we keep our majority in the Senate, not just to combat Trump's extremism, but to continue our fight for working families across the country. I'm doing everything I can to keep our Democratic Senate majority, but I need your support.

body:
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce with an important update.
**Our first FEC fundraising deadline of 2024 is less than one week away.** After that deadline on March 31, we’ll submit all of our fundraising numbers over the last three months into the public record — giving everyone, including Josh Hawley and the DC insiders propping him up, an inside look at our grassroots campaign.
**This deadline is our first opportunity this year to prove that our people-powered movement to take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat is strong and ready to win.**
So before I ask you to **[chip in $10 or just whatever you can afford toward our most ambitious end-of-quarter fundraising goal yet](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44736?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j) — 50,000 individual online donations — please let me share a little more about why this goal matters.**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44736?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j)**
**Before I explain anything else, I want you to know that this isn’t some arbitrary goal.** All of the goals our campaign emails you about are based in reality and, so far, grassroots supporters like you have helped us reach them at each critical benchmark.
But now that we’re in the “on-year,” being able to stay on track with our goals is more important than ever, especially as we look toward ramping up our organizing program, getting ads on TV, hiring more staff, and so much more over the months to come.
That’s why my team and I are going to do everything we can this week to hit this goal and make sure we’re prepared for the fight ahead — **including asking grassroots supporters like you to chip in $10, $25, or whatever you think is best before Sunday’s deadline.[Can I count on you to chip in today, Peter?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44736?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j)**
