[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44737?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=4&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44737?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=5&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44736?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j)
---
From the moment I got into this race last year, Josh Hawley and the DC insiders propping up his campaign have been determined to tear me down. That’s because, with help from grassroots supporters like you — chipping in and sharing our message when you can — we’ve made it clear: **our campaign is a real threat to their grip on Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.**
We’ve broken Missouri fundraising records quarter after quarter and built a truly people-powered coalition to take back this Senate seat, earning support from the Missouri AFL-CIO, the Missouri Fire Fighters, former statewide leaders like Jason Kander and Susan Montee, and dozens of local elected officials and community leaders all across the state. **Now, multiple polls even show this race in a dead heat!**
That’s why Hawley’s corporate mega-donors put millions into a brand new Super PAC to attack me — and it’s why national Republicans are transferring as much money as they can into Hawley’s campaign each quarter.
They know that Hawley is the most vulnerable GOP senator up for re-election this year. And they can tell we’ve built a powerful grassroots movement that’s capable of winning this race, flipping this U.S. Senate seat, and taking back power for real working people.
**So now, we need to be prepared to launch into the next phase of our campaign AND head off attacks from these shady insiders every day between now and Election Day** — and that’s why I’m asking for your help today, Peter.
**[Can I count on you to add a donation of $10, $25, or whatever you think is best today so we can hit our end-of-quarter goal, defeat Josh Hawley, and send a real warrior for working people to represent Missouri in the U.S. Senate? I’m not taking a cent from corporate PACs or shady mega-donors in this race, so I mean it when I say anything you can afford to give makes a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44736?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j)**

[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44737?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=8&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44737?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=9&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44737?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=10&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44737?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=11&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44737?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=12&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44737?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=13&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44736?refcode=em20240325-5124&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=14&akid=5124%2E614464%2Ex2gX-j)

**When we defeat Josh Hawley and flip this seat, I promise you this: We’re going to shake things up in the U.S. Senate.**
Together, we’ll secure voting rights, outlaw war profiteering, abolish corporate PACs, empower workers, and stand up to Big-Brother-style attacks on abortion and reproductive rights from control-obsessed politicians like Josh Hawley.
We’ll stop handing out money for Wall Street and forever wars, and start rebuilding communities in Missouri and all across the country. And we’ll create the next generation of energy jobs right here at home.
That’s what we’re fighting for in this movement. And I’m glad you’re a part of it.
Now let’s reach this goal together,
Lucas Kunce

| | Peter,
---
**Today, I** ’**m proud to endorse CAPT Hung Cao for U.S. Senate in Virginia.**

Hung is the American Dream and the true definition of an American hero.

He and his family escaped Communist Vietnam with little besides the clothes on their backs.

**And even though Hung came here not knowing a word of English, by the time he graduated high school, he had an appointment to the****N****aval Academy.**

After he graduated from the Naval Academy, he dedicated 25 years to serving on the front lines as a U.S. Navy Special Operations Officer.

Hung defused bombs to save the lives of men, women, and children in war zones and dove the depths of the oceans around the world to recover victims of plane crashes. His sacrifice protected America from our enemies.

_But just because he_ ’ _s hung up his uniform doesn_ ’ _t mean he_ ’ _s done fighting for America._

He sees every day how Joe Biden and Tim Kaine are destroying our country from the inside out. Hung will not stand for career politicians who forget the sacrifice of our Servicemembers. He knows he has a duty to remind Washington that they work for the American people.

**Hung isn** ’**t done fighting for America, and now, he needs you to fight for him so he can take****on Joe****Biden and the radical Left.**

* **They want you to believe inflation isn’t hurting your business or wallet They want to outlaw incandescent lightbulbs**
* **They want to outlaw gas stoves**
* **They want to outlaw ceiling fans**

| | The recent Presidential primary results starkly highlight the erosion of decency, democratic values, and community in rural Washington due to the hate-filled rhetoric of the far-Right, MAGA, and Christian Patriots.In Central/Eastern Washington, our youth are predominantly exposed to far-Right ideology through homeschooling, Republican party influences, media, peers, and private Christian Patriot schools. The argument that public schools indoctrinate liberal mindsets is debunked by the alarming embrace of MAGA among our youth.

However, we're lacking resources to properly educate and empower ourselves, leaving us on the losing end of a daunting battle.Despite our best efforts, the decline in Democratic involvement persists indicating the urgency for change. Continuing down the same path won't lead us to where we want to be—we must innovate, forge new paths, and be bold!

| | 3\. Citizen Action Keeps Yakima City MAGA Council In Check
---
| | Your signature is needed! Visit Single Hill Brewery, Essencia Bakery, or Catalyst Coffee. Click [here](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ffOvpZyJH/c?w=wYSrGkTldOBtJwCEn-fyxx-PcfO33hP4Vk-txuCLWLI.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly90aW55dXJsLmNvbS8zZTNkeGR0bSIsInIiOiI4Mjc2YjU2OC0wMTNhLTQyNmUtYmViZi1hNjYwMDc3MDZmNDIiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) to receive instructions and support in signing the petitions.Two weeks ago, your support made a significant impact in our email campaign. It urged the majority of far-right Yakima City Council members to reconsider their plan of amending or [eliminating crucial community councils](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ffOvpZyJH/c?w=LGJ-aEmqn16jm6CrEFrVf-ib8CIHT_yIsZ3ajQN_SWc.), which would have limited public input. Thank you for rattling their cages. Now, it's time to take further action and regain control. Coleen Anderson, mentioned in our previous newsletter, is leading a petition drive to halt the implementation of their actions, as outlined in the Yakima City Charter: Chapter four, section three. We need to gather eight hundred signatures on three petitions from Yakima City residents by April 4th, 2024, to ensure they are collated and vetted on time before submission.The city council members have already engaged in questionable actions aimed at consolidating their power and shielding themselves from external oversight and accountability. Essentially, they are executing Project 2025, as outlined by [Heather Cox Richards](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ffOvpZyJH/c?w=7Qr0WEdKZXpLiCbZKFbZi_OTVC5JFujZegGw_rKzfMg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGVhdGhlcmNveHJpY2hhcmRzb24vcC9tYXJjaC0xNy0yMDI0P3I9Mmw1bm1pJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1wb3N0JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwiLCJyIjoiODI3NmI1NjgtMDEzYS00MjZlLWJlYmYtYTY2MDA3NzA2ZjQyIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0), to strategically dominate the Yakima City governmental processes. Time Sensitive Opportunities: Don’t Miss Out Next installment: Dominick Bonney returns with a gripping narrative on the rise of Christian Nationalism in C/E Washington. | | | | | 1\. Breaking: Equal Delegate Access for Central & Eastern WA Dems | | Make history and be part of the time-honored process to nominate President Biden as the 2024 Democratic candidate. Just a few minutes of your time, and the meeting in April is via Zoom, no travel required. | | | | The Washington State Dems have made a historic change! Now, Central & Eastern Washington have equal access to the delegate process. Previously, delegate allocation favored Western LDs, but no more. This is our chance to level the playing field. If we don't seize it, Seattle could regain dominance. Any Democrat can participate—it's quick and easy, just three minutes. The hybrid April election allows remote participation via Zoom, no travel needed. Let's ensure Central & Eastern WA voices are heard loud and clear. Spread the word and join us in this pivotal moment! | | | | | | | 2\. Where Have AllOur Children Gone? | | The recent Presidential primary results starkly highlight the erosion of decency, democratic values, and community in rural Washington due to the hate-filled rhetoric of the far-Right, MAGA, and Christian Patriots.In Central/Eastern Washington, our youth are predominantly exposed to far-Right ideology through homeschooling, Republican party influences, media, peers, and private Christian Patriot schools. The argument that public schools indoctrinate liberal mindsets is debunked by the alarming embrace of MAGA among our youth. | | | | Victimized for too long, we're becoming accustomed to feeling unsafe in our own homes and communities, with nowhere to turn for help.I'm immensely grateful for those tirelessly upholding democratic values in Central/Eastern Washington. However, we're lacking resources to properly educate and empower ourselves, leaving us on the losing end of a daunting battle.Despite our best efforts, the decline in Democratic involvement persists indicating the urgency for change. Continuing down the same path won't lead us to where we want to be—we must innovate, forge new paths, and be bold! | | | | Rural Americans United (RAU), alongside other organizations, is pioneering change. We're revamping our successful pro-democratic messaging campaign to deliver even greater impact and faster change. With our Advisory Board, we're embarking on another first for Central/Eastern Washington—using our messaging project to listen to our neighbors. Gathering data on rural needs outside of government interest, we're planning a long-term strategy to solicit opinions, interests, and needs through various media. This data will inform campaigns, nonprofits, policymaking, and more, giving a voice to Central and Eastern Washington.Join us in celebrating and supporting these vital efforts. Together, we can make a difference. -Data was compiled from the Washington Secretary of State Voter Data Portal | | | | | | | 3\. Citizen Action Keeps Yakima City MAGA Council In Check | | Your signature is needed! Visit Single Hill Brewery, Essencia Bakery, or Catalyst Coffee. Click to receive instructions and support in signing the petitions.Two weeks ago, your support made a significant impact in our email campaign. It urged the majority of far-right Yakima City Council members to reconsider their plan of amending or , which would have limited public input. Thank you for rattling their cages. Now, it's time to take further action and regain control. Coleen Anderson, mentioned in our previous newsletter, is leading a petition drive to halt the implementation of their actions, as outlined in the Yakima City Charter: Chapter four, section three. We need to gather eight hundred signatures on three petitions from Yakima City residents by April 4th, 2024, to ensure they are collated and vetted on time before submission.The city council members have already engaged in questionable actions aimed at consolidating their power and shielding themselves from external oversight and accountability. Essentially, they are executing Project 2025, as outlined by , to strategically dominate the Yakima City governmental processes. Testing Project 2025 at the local level presents an ideal opportunity, given the limited oversight, personnel, and checks and balances in local governments.For more information, | | | | | 4\. Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly.
Look, I’ll get right to the point. If we’re going to hold the line in Arizona, keep control of the Senate, and keep Trump out of the White House, I need you to chip in to Ruben Gallego’s campaign for U.S. Senate.

Tammy and I both agree that it is critical that we keep this seat, and the Senate, in Democratic control. Unity is vital. We will continue our efforts to strengthen our democracy in New Jersey while we come together to stand up against the dangerous agenda pushed by Trump. This race was never about Andy Kim vs. Tammy Murphy. The decision to run against Senator Menendez was one of the most consequential decisions of my life. The reason I stepped up is that I'm tired of constantly watching our politics fail our nation. We are just cycling from crisis to crisis, and too many politicians aren't focused on what the American people need help with. Right now, a staggering 84 percent of people in New Jersey believe NJ politicians are corrupt. The people of New Jersey deserve a choice for what kind of public servant they have in the Senate. Instead of throwing up my hands and giving up, I am stepping up to show that there is a better way. We deserve leaders who can serve with integrity. Leaders who are workhorses, not show horses. After Menendez's scandal, we need a fresh new start — a chance to lift up a new generation of leadership that can bring a new voice and deep public service experience to the U.S. Senate. It's been clear for some time that our campaign's momentum is incredible. Poll after poll showed us with a strong lead in the head-to-head horse race. Now, we've gone from being the underdog to the frontrunner and are the only campaign with statewide name recognition left in this race. There's a long way to go between now and November though – and with the news that Bob Menendez may run as an Independent – we need to make sure that we sustain and keep growing our momentum to unify our party and build a broad coalition of support for keeping this seat blue in November. = = More soon, Andy | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | Paid for by Andy Kim for New Jersey | This email was sent by . Communism is on the rise--yes, here in America. Some may describe what we're all experiencing as something other than communism. Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson may simply describe the government's efforts to control what you can and cannot say over social media apps as being impeded by that pesky "First Amendment hamstringing the government in significant ways."
The problem with today's Americans is that we've always been free. We don't know anything other. Fortunately for us, people are speaking out--people who have lived under communism and escaped it.

subject: Fire and brimstone

My fellow Americans - this is Speaker Mike Johnson.

| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Speaker Mike Johnson.

_You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists. _

So you can imagine the immediate wrath I faced when I went on record supporting Donald J. Trump for President. I was just talking to my friend, Steve Scalise - he faced the same thing when he endorsed Trump too.

_**[He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we've got to stick together.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d65823825ac44fae8394d46550cdf464&_e=DPGJ043kf9NytSASXtJbhghoUzcpH9MawDjqqwa2PztvT4pdb3FzPj9n8OCfRIDyCQXsFJcq7TIiwTu5gQpEWBIB0VLZRwlpbmBz_fWkzy3EyceodwNWbK1P8FbkQvW0K9Jzkgjq_eP1E7HRRw6gBMf5Ok5GEkF3r_AiZmC_iUWQ5jDDbBqECgIjsKPsJpRAJ-CforjgSHZ7UcPTt2dSgYyWuziU2ZtoF1R4H2nn-kIYfWiN7hb-ry3uZECMkxSj8U5Rmmf4X8SJKis3zOFfOqLnIsMmaiQjv_bHh6SV-qvARIrTOMxxx2uRfsq-NsqR5PZPSEoeGNNiav5Tg2lcoMU5bEglFYvHWvqcq8H1I_LmeuNJECCB7-gNL-q9Qlspp9FIr7nD2t8425AaP9IO-xDeLNAwqZVO-KYWqx4md3MIIjQEgHLLRnnU9U_hvCGT_EKZ3iz94KR0W725CtULig%3D%3D "He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we’ve got to stick together.")**_

That's because the anti-Trump Media... Young radicals on college campuses... the holier-than-thou elites in Hollywood... Democrat Super PACs... Joe Biden's army of megadonors... They are fully committed to destroying our movement and replacing EVERY LAST ONE OF US with a Liberal Democrat.

But wait, that's not even the half of it. It gets worse:
** Problem #1: ** We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

** Problem #2: ** House Democrats have forty million bucks stashed away to attack pro-Trump Conservatives like us.

** Problem #3: ** Joe Biden just bragged about raising a million bucks in a SINGLE DAY attacking President Trump.
I cannot stress the urgency of the situation enough. Early voting is about to start in the first Special Election AND the Left's fundraising advantage grows by the minute...

_**[So as one of my first moves of the election year, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d65823825ac44fae8394d46550cdf464&_e=DPGJ043kf9NytSASXtJbhghoUzcpH9MawDjqqwa2PztvT4pdb3FzPj9n8OCfRIDyCQXsFJcq7TIiwTu5gQpEWBIB0VLZRwlpbmBz_fWkzy3EyceodwNWbK1P8FbkQvW0K9Jzkgjq_eP1E7HRRw6gBMf5Ok5GEkF3r_AiZmC_iUWQ5jDDbBqECgIjsKPsJpRAJ-CforjgSHZ7UcPTt2dSgYyWuziU2ZtoF1R4H2nn-kIYfWiN7hb-ry3uZECMkxSj8U5Rmmf4X8SJKis3zOFfOqLnIsMmaiQjv_bHh6SV-qvARIrTOMxxx2uRfsq-NsqRQNY56h8Fb8haAGCNQwAiybufKGUO9OyIDJLyt2eIj1KHct2I05aOV_LdmImp5daF4gNE1WVJkjr8gGrNUchGVwytzDf-enYVRNiZSRq9JAmsKxXvWWZZjvobY-C2wH-hIkZS4rCafvihVGcSsqidWQ%3D%3D "So as one of my first moves of the election year, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

I know, I know - that's a big goal. I get that. But that's as low as I could possibly make it to fully fund our campaign operations in every must-win swing state.

If we fail to hit it, the consequences would be unthinkable. We'd have no choice but to: **1) ** SCRAP our get-out-the-vote operations, **2) ** SLASH the budget for our ad campaigns, and **3) ** Throw our digital outreach plans IN THE TRASH CAN.

Nothing - and I mean NOTHING - would be worse for our plans to defend our razor-thin House Majority. **That 's why I'm calling for reinforcements. **

_I know the economy is in bad shape under Joe Biden. So if that 's preventing you from pitching in $100 or $50 - I completely understand. But if you can afford JUST $10 or even $5, I would be grateful beyond measure. _

_**[I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d65823825ac44fae8394d46550cdf464&_e=DPGJ043kf9NytSASXtJbhghoUzcpH9MawDjqqwa2PztvT4pdb3FzPj9n8OCfRIDyCQXsFJcq7TIiwTu5gQpEWBIB0VLZRwlpbmBz_fWkzy3EyceodwNWbK1P8FbkQvW0K9Jzkgjq_eP1E7HRRw6gBMf5Ok5GEkF3r_AiZmC_iUWQ5jDDbBqECgIjsKPsJpRAJ-CforjgSHZ7UcPTt2dSgYyWuziU2ZtoF1R4H2nn-kIYfWiN7hb-ry3uZECMkxSj8U5Rmmf4X8SJKis3zOFfOqLnIsMmaiQjv_bHh6SV-qvARIrTOMxxx2uRfsq-NsqR97nFjbys8KlVEAZlSrIzwE6MLpq3X4E6R-aNegPNnAPoZRkSK1EiO8Ddm5Ash0cwjUDJ69aK4kolLPoelvehsSrs5EMLc6NXJ7yj5FW03svc-XvvApKaYttDGTBSSxXhlSnZsyPEK5NuTTr6yjSDKg%3D%3D "I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.")**_

When the stakes are this high, that's what will be the difference between saving our Republican Majority and losing to the Trump-hating Democrats. So can I count on you to pitch in SOMETHING?

Thank you for being part of Team Hogan! This is the first of what will be periodic roundups to help keep folks informed and share with you some snapshots from the trail.
**ON THE ROAD:** Where we’ve been
**Wednesday, March 13.** Governor Hogan and his staff (past and present!) stopped by the Ruth M. Kirk Recreation and Learning Center in Baltimore City to donate food in honor of National Good Samaritan Day. The center is run by the governor’s good friend, Arthur “Squeaky” Kirk.
| | | | | | | | |
---
|

[Click HERE to view and share the full album.](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=f4268265e3&e=3ef74f1f93)
**Friday, March 15.** At Beth Sholom Congregation in Montgomery County, Governor Hogan addressed the Jewish Community Relations Council of Greater Washington on the importance of standing with Israel.
[Click HERE to watch and share the Governor’s remarks.](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=5c6f3a8c19&e=3ef74f1f93)
Back in Annapolis, Governor Hogan took part in the 9th Annual St. Patrick's Hooley, where he had the opportunity to honor Maryland’s First Responder of the Year.
[Click here to view and share the full album](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=214bc66325&e=3ef74f1f93)[Click here to see Governor Hogan honor Officer Horne.](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=deb761e69d&e=3ef74f1f93)
**Saturday, March 16.** After stopping at Bay Country Bakery in Cambridge for breakfast, Governor Hogan joined thousands of Marylanders for the Ocean City St. Patrick’s Day parade.
| | | | | | | | |

[Click HERE to see more from the Governor’s stop at Bay Country Bakery](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=b95f8b7424&e=3ef74f1f93)[Click HERE to view and share the full album from the Ocean City Parade](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=8ad75bd3f2&e=3ef74f1f93)
**Sunday, March 17.** Governor Hogan and the Hogan for Maryland team spent St. Patrick’s Day in downtown Annapolis, hanging out with the Maryland Professional Firefighters and meeting Marylanders on West Street and Main Street.
| | | | | | | | |

**WORD ON THE STREET (AND ON THE RADIO)**
Governor Hogan continues to stand with hardworking Marylanders against tax increase proposals coming out of Annapolis: **“It's deja vu all over again—the same crushing tax hikes that convinced me to run for Governor in the first place are rearing their ugly head again.”**
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=a1937f62a1&e=3ef74f1f93)
He also joined WMAL Radio to talk about taxes, violent crime, and the border crisis: _**“We absolutely must secure and close the border. ... There is a path forward and it starts with securing the border, and then as Ronald Regan wanted to do, find a way to fix the broken immigration system”**_
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ae771a8ac3&e=3ef74f1f93)
Governor Hogan sounded the alarm on Congress’ misguided priorities when it comes to keeping Americans safe: _**“Close the border, not the government.”**_
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=61c81a22ba&e=3ef74f1f93)
In case you missed it, Governor Hogan responded to a new Washington Post-UMD poll showing him leading both potential Democratic opponents: _**“I am always humbled by the support of Marylanders, but make no mistake, we are the underdogs in this race. The partisan politicians in Washington will do anything they can to stop us.”**_
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=5a2c232afd&e=3ef74f1f93)
Today, Governor Hogan wished all Marylanders a very happy Maryland Day!
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=432be10daa&e=3ef74f1f93)
If you’d like to join us on our next adventure, [be sure to sign up to get involved with the campaign today!](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=4cef07ee78&e=3ef74f1f93)
Let’s get back to work!
Kyle**Team Hogan**

body:
#
Friends -
We have exciting news! We are proud to endorse Andy Kim for U.S. Senate!
Here at the Long Run, when we think of changemaking pro-democracy candidates, there is no better example than Andy.
Born and raised in New Jersey, Andy embodies the American dream. He’s the son of Korean immigrants, the product of New Jersey public schools, a public servant, husband, and proud dad.
Andy has devoted himself to public service. He’s a leading national security expert – working at the Pentagon and in Afghanistan as a civilian advisor to the military, and in 2018, he made history by being the first AAPI federally elected official from New Jersey.
But after seeing the chaos, dysfunction, and extremism in politics, Andy decided to roll up his sleeves to step up and fight for his family, neighbors, the community that raised him, and working families across New Jersey. Now he is running to represent New Jersey in the U.S. Senate and is building a movement to restore trust and integrity in the U.S. Senate.
Now more than ever we need a new generation of leadership in the U.S. Senate that can boldly take on the challenges working people face daily — Andy Kim embodies that leadership.
He's put in the work, he's proven he can deliver, and he deserves our support.

Dear Peter,
You’ve probably heard by now that I’m about to announce my running mate, the person who will stand by my side as Vice President.
Despite some misinformation circulating in the press, rest assured that I will set the record straight tomorrow in Oakland.
I am thrilled to introduce this remarkable individual who will not only serve as my partner in governance but will also embody the qualities needed to lead our great nation.
While I cannot tell you who it is right now, I can confidently say that they are the perfect companion to navigate the challenges ahead. And I’ll give you another hint: _this announcement is really going to shake up the political establishment_.
[I’d love for you to join me in Oakland to welcome this dynamic person into our campaign.](https://www.kennedy24.com/vp-announcement?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vp_announc_rfk_3_25_24_rs_a4&n=5)

clean_body: | | | Our Supreme Court has been plagued by corruption, and Justices violate laws and ethics with impunity... yet they remain on the bench indefinitely! Right now, we are stuck with a bench dominated by religious zealots and radicals who defend the interests of the wealthy and corporations over the rule of law and justice. Without significant reform, it will stay that way. The TERM Act would establish an 18 year term limit for current and future Supreme Court Justices and establish a nomination process in the first and third year of each presidential term. | The lack of term limits for Justices on the US Supreme Court has led to a lack of accountability and transparency in the judicial branch. The lifetime appointments have been politicized, and the Justices are out of touch with the current social and political climate, making it difficult for them to make informed decisions that reflect the will of the people. Term limits would reduce the partisanship of the Court by removing the incentive for political parties to engage in ideological battles over Court appointments, leading to a more balanced and impartial judiciary. Presidents come and go, but the Supreme Court goes on forever... let’s change that! -Cedar Key Progress Cedar Key Progress support Democrats in competitive Southern districts who are building a diverse, inclusive, and just future. | | | Peter, Americans are DYING because of Joe Biden’s border crisis. There’s no way around it.

We’re letting criminals into our country without background checks and they’ve murdered innocent Americans.

body:
Judicial Watch announced recently it filed a Georgia Open Records Act lawsuit against the University of Georgia Police Department for audio of any 911 call about nursing student Laken Riley who was assaulted and murdered, allegedly by illegal alien Jose Antonio Ibarra on the university campus. The lawsuit also demands the initial arrest report of Ibarra for the February 22, 2024, murder of Riley.

Friend, In an election year like this, it’s easy to get caught up in the horse race, in the polls, in the news cycles. But today (before I ask you to [**chip in a $10 split donation between WisDems and Nikki Budzinski**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81634512/463047049/329332713?amount=10&refcode=AU_NJB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240325_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMzE0OWEwOC1jZGVhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YzZ8XJ0QTrHHCBNjf9j6649sAzqU2ZpEn6Bgcu1jDao=)), I want to take a step back and look at the big picture. Here at WisDems HQ, we’re in the thick of the 2024 election. But for the people who will ultimately decide this election, it’s still incredibly early. In all likelihood, swing voters haven’t tuned in yet. They’ve probably forgotten what life was like under Donald Trump, and haven’t heard much about President Biden’s accomplishments and his plan to build a brighter future for our communities. And I don’t see that as a problem, friend; I see it as an opportunity. Most people don’t know yet that Donald Trump has promised to be a dictator on “day one,” that he’s proposed an extreme agenda to gut Social Security and Medicare, attack rights for LGBTQ+ Americans, and impose a new national ban on abortion. They also don’t know that President Biden has achieved historic success in his first term – lowering costs for working families, rebuilding the middle class, and fighting to restore freedom and democracy after the disastrous Trump years. Don’t get me wrong – this is going to be a close race, and Wisconsin will probably come down to a handful of votes per precinct. But whatever the results are, they’ll fall within the margin of effort. **We have a clear path to victory. We have a winning message of empathy, decency, freedom, and democracy. clean_body: | = Friend, In an election year like this, it’s easy to get caught up in the horse race, in the polls, in the news cycles. But today (before I ask you to =), I want to take a step back and look at the big picture. Here at WisDems HQ, we’re in the thick of the 2024 election. But for the people who will ultimately decide this election, it’s still incredibly early. In all likelihood, swing voters haven’t tuned in yet. They’ve probably forgotten what life was like under Donald Trump, and haven’t heard much about President Biden’s accomplishments and his plan to build a brighter future for our communities. And I don’t see that as a problem, friend; I see it as an opportunity. Most people don’t know yet that Donald Trump has promised to be a dictator on “day one,” that he’s proposed an extreme agenda to gut Social Security and Medicare, attack rights for LGBTQ+ Americans, and impose a new national ban on abortion. They also don’t know that President Biden has achieved historic success in his first term – lowering costs for working families, rebuilding the middle class, and fighting to restore freedom and democracy after the disastrous Trump years. Don’t get me wrong – this is going to be a close race, and Wisconsin will probably come down to a handful of votes per precinct. But whatever the results are, they’ll fall within the margin of effort. We have a clear path to victory. We have a winning message of empathy, decency, freedom, and democracy. | | Friend,
---
Unfortunately, the madness of the March is not just confined to college basketball games.
---
We were able to fund the federal government — 175 days into the fiscal year — only because of Democrats in the House of Representatives. And, the dysfunction of the Republican controlled House continues to delay progress on some really important issues, like supporting our ally Ukraine as they stand on the frontline of the global fight to protect democracy and rule of law.
---
Even worse, the Republican Study Committee, which a vast majority of the Republicans in the House belong to, released their budget calling for raises to the Social Security retirement age for future retirees, cuts Medicare, repeals key elements of the ACA, and says that life begins at conception.
---
We deserve better.
---
Every day, I am proud to meet with Rhode Islanders who reignite my belief that tomorrow will be better than today.
---
We can fight to build on the historic investments to combat the climate crisis, protect reproductive freedom so women can make their own health care decisions, reduce costs of prescription drugs, and expand economic opportunity from the middle out and bottom up to make the American Dream real for more people.

| | Hi Peter, Welcome to my team’s monthly newsletter of what I’ve been up to this month, so you can be in the loop about the great work happening. **Oregon legislators wrapped up the 2024 legislative session!**

**Tina’s housing production package passed.**
The package of bills aimed at increasing housing production and lowering costs are bold and comprehensive — and an important step forward to ease Oregon’s housing and homelessness challenges. As the only bill the Governor introduced this year, this was her number one priority of the session, and she’s proud it passed with bipartisan support.

**We’re ramping up summer learning.**

subject: This week in Texas - March 25

body:
[1]Powered By People

Here’s what Powered by People is working on this week:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Pushing for real border solutions

Trump, Abbott, and others in the Republican Party are trafficking in
dangerous conspiracy theories about immigrants — that they’re an “invading
army,” that they’re coming to “replace us,” that they’re “poisoning the
blood of America” — and then using those lies to push policies that have
done nothing but worsen the crisis at our border.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63248?t=1001&akid=239532%2E444211%2EGUEsGm ]I joined the show Real Time with Bill Maher to shine a spotlight on how
dangerous this is for Texas and for our country and to have an honest
conversation about this issue. My hope is that the more we boldly push for
real border solutions, the sooner we can achieve the safe, legal, orderly
immigration system that we desperately need.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63248?t=1002&akid=239532%2E444211%2EGUEsGm ]WATCH

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Electing a pro-choice majority

Texas’ extreme abortion ban continues to force women to carry dangerous,
nonviable pregnancies that could kill them. While the law is supposed to
provide medical exceptions in cases where a woman’s life is at risk,
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63249?t=1003&akid=239532%2E444211%2EGUEsGm ]the language is too vague to protect doctors who could face life in
prison for performing an emergency abortion.

Amid this chaos and confusion, Kate Cox went to the Texas Supreme Court in
December to seek permission for an emergency abortion. But the justices
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60601?t=1004&akid=239532%2E444211%2EGUEsGm ]denied her appeal. They ruled that it’s not the judicial branch’s job
to make medical decisions and called on the Texas Medical Board to clear
up any confusion among physicians.

The Board agreed last week to craft guidance on when an emergency abortion
may be permitted. But the [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63253?t=1005&akid=239532%2E444211%2EGUEsGm ]draft guidance they issued on Friday merely
echoed the vague language in existing law. In defending their proposed
rule, they said, “We do not have discretion in rewriting the law...That has
to be a legislative action.”

Clearly, the courts are not going to save us from these dangerous laws.
Neither are our state’s medical regulators — and to be clear, it shouldn’t
be their job to do it. The only way to change this is through our upcoming
elections.

This November, we have an extraordinary chance to re-elect President Biden
and secure a pro-choice majority in both the House and Senate. If we do
that, we can pass nationwide abortion protections and reverse these
dangerous laws in states like Texas.

But we have to put in the work to win.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Registering and organizing Texas voters

Powered by People has thousands of volunteers who are registering and
organizing new Democratic voters across the state. This past week, we
ramped up our work on college campuses to help bring as many young people
as possible into the 2024 elections.

With this being the first presidential election since the fall of Roe v.
Wade, I’m confident that if we ensure students know that this election is
about restoring nationwide abortion rights and advancing other issues of
outsized importance to young people, we’ll have a much better shot at
electing the leaders who will make this possible.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63251?source=ema20240325-239532&t=1006&akid=239532%2E444211%2EGUEsGm ]If you live in Texas, sign up to help us reach the young people who
could decide this election. Join us for a virtual Volunteer Deputy
Registrar training, and then we’ll put you to work.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63251?source=ema20240325-239532&t=1007&akid=239532%2E444211%2EGUEsGm ]SIGN UP

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240325.jKYX2x&refcode=ema20240325-239532&t=1008&akid=239532%2E444211%2EGUEsGm ]Otherwise, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution today. Your
support will ensure we have the resources to register and turn out young
voters across the state.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240325.jKYX2x&refcode=ema20240325-239532&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1027&akid=239532%2E444211%2EGUEsGm ]CONTRIBUTE

Thank you for joining us in this work.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

I hope it’s a great week for you.

Beto

body:
I’m Hill, and this is my story.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y)
Hey Peter,
In a minute I’d like to reintroduce myself and share my story, but first: **[My campaign has a critical end-of-quarter deadline coming up this Sunday, and _every_ dollar is critical to our success. Will you rush any amount -- no matter how small -- to hit our goal before the deadline?](https://act.hillharper.com/go/812?t=2&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y)**
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/812?t=3&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y)
**[DONATE »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/812?t=4&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y)**
I've worn many hats throughout my life, from lawyer to union organizer, author to actor, and cancer survivor to single father. I’m a small business owner, too -- I have a well-known coffee shop right here in Detroit. **But above all, I'm a servant leader driven by a passion for making life better for everyone around me.**
Growing up in the Midwest with two doctor parents, I learned early on the value of public service. It's a lesson that has stayed with me throughout my life, from my days at Harvard Law School to my time on the set of The Good Doctor. I've always believed that true leadership means putting the needs of the people above personal ambition, and I’ve committed myself to building a career that reflects those values.
That's why I was proud to serve on President Obama’s Cancer Panel. It's why I've written books to empower marginalized young people and established a foundation to help them achieve their dreams. It’s why I joined the UAW and SAG-AFTRA strikes last year to support their fight for better pay and working conditions.
**Now, I'm running for the U.S. Senate because I believe that the challenges facing our nation demand new, dynamic leadership -- not the same bought-and-paid-for politicians who let us down year after year.** We need responsive leaders who will put public service over personal gain, fight for our most urgent priorities, and embody the authentic representation that every Michigander deserves.
But I can't do it alone. And since I’m not taking a cent of corporate PAC money, I need your help to build a grassroots movement that puts the power back in the hands of the people.
**[My campaign’s critical end-of-quarter deadline is coming up this Sunday, Peter. Please, chip in $5-- or anything that works for you -- to reach my campaign’s $25,000 fundraising goal by the midnight deadline.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/814?t=6&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y)**
_If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[DONATE $5 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/815?t=7&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y) [DONATE $25 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/816?t=8&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y) [DONATE $50 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/817?t=9&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y) [DONATE $100 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/818?t=10&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y) [DONATE $250 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/819?t=11&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y) [OTHER AMOUNT »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/812?t=12&akid=1110%2E62735%2EsJQ30y)

Together, we can make history in Michigan. Let’s do this together.
Hill Harper
Democrat for U.S. Senate

name: David Nammo, Christian Legal Society
subject: State Department rule violates religious beliefs
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

,

Christian relief organizations are in the
crosshairs of the U.S. State Department ... BECAUSE of their
Christian faith!

Will you stand with Christian Legal Society in
support of faith-based relief organizations today? Add your name
to our urgent open letter to the U.S. State Department.

Say NO to the State Department targeting Christian

The U.S. State Department has just proposed new
regulations that will cut off grants and contracts to
Christian-and all faith-based-relief organizations that require
their employees to share their faith and their religious values.

That means that relief organizations like
Samaritan's Purse, a Christian ministry that has helped millions
worldwide since its founding in 1970 ...

Humanitarian organizations like World Vision, which
has supported children in need and empowered millions of people
out of poverty for more than 70 years ...

And many thousands more faith-based ministry,
relief, and aid organizations of all sizes that do immeasurable
good work in God's name across the globe ...

May be forced to SCALE DOWN-or SHUT DOWN-their
operations, as they are unconstitutionally targeted for
de-funding because of their Christian faith.

, Christian Legal Society is standing
alongside religious groups and ministries to oppose this
unconstitutional and immoral regulatory change from the U.S.
State Department. Will you add your name to our open letter to
join in this fight?

Say NO to the State Department targeting
Christians

, no faith-based organization in America
today should be forced to reject biblical principles ... and
embrace the government's currently preferred social ideology ...
or risk scaling down or shutting down their operations.

Yet under the regulatory change that the U.S. State
Department has proposed, funding and contracts could be denied to
ANY group that has a statement of faith or policies that are true
to biblical values but counter to today's predominantly "woke"
social climate.

That means organizations that protect life instead
of promoting abortion, advocate for traditional marriage and
family, or follow biblical teaching on biological sex rather than
"gender ideology" are at risk of being targeted-and punished!-by
the U.S. government.

Please stand with Christian Legal Society to
express your strong opposition to the U.S. State Department
targeting Christian and all faith-based relief organizations on
the basis of their religious beliefs! Add your name to our urgent
open letter now.

Say NO to the State Department targeting
Christians

Since 1961, Christian Legal Society has been
dedicated to serving Jesus Christ through the practice and study
of law, the defense of religious freedom and life, and the
provision of legal aid to the needy.

And for nearly 50 years, Christian Legal Society's
Center for Law & Religious Freedom, which is spearheading the
response to this proposed rule change, has defended and advanced
all Americans' inalienable rights to religious freedom and life
in the public square.

This is one of the most urgent-and important-fights
that we face for religious freedom this year, and I am grateful
for concerned Americans like you coming alongside us to defend
Christian and all faith-based relief organizations in the battle
today.

Thank you for your prayers and for your
consideration.

David Nammo

Executive Director & CEO

Christian Legal Society

Christian Legal Society

P.O. Box 7712

McLean, VA 22106-7712

525-K East Market Street # 114

City: Leesburg

subject: Does the next generation share your beliefs?
body:
Shifts in our society threaten to dilute our nation's character

|
---
| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0bb4a03e6449496f96e64b5178f866cf&_e=sxJFPF9Deo0dnC-CAZrTrvPwhJC2ykVJ9m92RQgj2l04Z7Zq4J1gA5Ed1yNR0B9mqaAgVMx-7PYBI9IpAMIS9cGyEc2qqriWMY3b2VS9cMUdJRSK87tmhDTPrT9Tqg0f75VVYHhlstvIv2kSVHfudwK4DzPuLfAj4BuzJOKUo9LbekOiLEkK54x73BprjirrOi_FvCpcuZh9eVBqH78evOZQOe2_6d24rLSUblvIDplksgRGVvtyV1mI6foZHTFOXMNsKnZ98DZLfYGp_ipJD-3G_R29AIlKJhiiwQSjWtvazgBmeX-i9emaNwOA6Dy67pwpIff9xTjI46l0LwiNjl8n9KUp0wGvsx-AfCL7cpRP8F1RTL0zok855aaaLPxQpZWQMZkdB77tnONNfq1nQQbW9oo5s_EYcnQTWf5WqZA%3D)
---
| Dear Fellow Patriot,

I believe that America stands at a crossroads. Our individual freedoms, the nation's respect for the Constitution, and the legacy of our Founders are all enduring relentless assaults. Shifts in our society threaten to dilute our nation's character while biased media and divisive politics amplify it greater than ever.

The people that this impacts the most are not you and I-_It is our future generation._ Our children and grandchildren are being taught that that is their skin that defines them, not the content of their character. They are being taught that our nation's history is something to be ashamed of. [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0bb4a03e6449496f96e64b5178f866cf&_e=sxJFPF9Deo0dnC-CAZrTrvPwhJC2ykVJ9m92RQgj2l04Z7Zq4J1gA5Ed1yNR0B9mqaAgVMx-7PYBI9IpAMIS9cGyEc2qqriWMY3b2VS9cMUdJRSK87tmhDTPrT9Tqg0f75VVYHhlstvIv2kSVHfudwK4DzPuLfAj4BuzJOKUo9LbekOiLEkK54x73BprjirrOi_FvCpcuZh9eVBqH78evOZQOe2_6d24rLSUblvIDplksgRGVvtyV1mI6foZHTFOXMNsKnZ98DZLfYGp_ipJD9XFsJy7koht9aCPdPgpfyXykK4e3_qrOB6iHrAo93jHkwlRl_wxVZY1fLRW2MYtHUS3Nt_PtjzXFjWMF4_4WrwVNpPq_HMfXgWG7-PXQ-cPF05ZYcjv2d21L0MNMVrqIICMfIV2dGnY7UOeoz68Rdg%3D) Candidly, it just doesn't make any sense.

But, I believe we can change this. I believe we can build a future that upholds the values of faith, liberty, community, and life - a future where all Americans are free to pursue their ideas, goals, and faith.

This won't be possible without your involvement. I've created a simple pledge; a way to align us all around a set of shared beliefs. [I want to invite you to take the Common Sense Pledge.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0bb4a03e6449496f96e64b5178f866cf&_e=sxJFPF9Deo0dnC-CAZrTrvPwhJC2ykVJ9m92RQgj2l04Z7Zq4J1gA5Ed1yNR0B9mqaAgVMx-7PYBI9IpAMIS9cGyEc2qqriWMY3b2VS9cMUdJRSK87tmhDTPrT9Tqg0f75VVYHhlstvIv2kSVHfudwK4DzPuLfAj4BuzJOKUo9LbekOiLEkK54x73BprjirrOi_FvCpcuZh9eVBqH78evOZQOe2_6d24rLSUblvIDpneZTbuYRB45B_UN1b4_3m-DLm3GVDA0KyV0d4QcLdzac5KKM1srSnPTpQfjnbpMTD38fRnUpBHdMi33KH4QnZ_58y4VUTlE66HVd4Nvaky79VubGsmZRawhwzeN5HBeWRyOZh2waf9-M5O9k4j8IA1jIAq27sf1i2aUK2Pq1XF4g%3D%3D)

We cannot bring about this necessary change without you. By signing this pledge, you are committing to uphold the principles our nation was founded on and teach them to the next generations. **Just one person can make a difference, and it can start with you.**

This is not a passive petition; it's an active pledge to uphold the common sense values that shaped our great nation.

Sign the Common Sense Pledge today using this secure link: [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/common-sense-pledge/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0bb4a03e6449496f96e64b5178f866cf&_e=sxJFPF9Deo0dnC-CAZrTrvPwhJC2ykVJ9m92RQgj2l04Z7Zq4J1gA5Ed1yNR0B9mqaAgVMx-7PYBI9IpAMIS9cGyEc2qqriWMY3b2VS9cMUdJRSK87tmhDTPrT9Tqg0f75VVYHhlstvIv2kSVHfudwK4DzPuLfAj4BuzJOKUo9LbekOiLEkK54x73BprjirrOi_FvCpcuZh9eVBqH78evOZQOe2_6d24rLSUblvIDpneZTbuYRB45B_UN1b4_3m-2Dfs7cU0eaut1wXGCLssDtEcAsH1FV4qpEtzyJx9DTXxHKlqL_ts0Cxi5T0-bWMS7XLyoGNXP9k06kB2MWvASYekdsoCNvIsKXAVV7Vd79VZXCSf_w927rJJQd4ijIbqYwC_G06JiS33ivbANJaXag%3D%3D)

Together, we can shape a future that respects our shared history, protects our hard-earned freedoms, and prioritizes common sense. Your involvement is critical - are you ready to take action?

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

clean_body: Shifts in our society threaten to dilute our nation's character | | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot, I believe that America stands at a crossroads. Our individual freedoms, the nation's respect for the Constitution, and the legacy of our Founders are all enduring relentless assaults. Shifts in our society threaten to dilute our nation's character while biased media and divisive politics amplify it greater than ever. The people that this impacts the most are not you and I-It is our future generation. Our children and grandchildren are being taught that that is their skin that defines them, not the content of their character. They are being taught that our nation's history is something to be ashamed of. Candidly, it just doesn't make any sense. But, I believe we can change this. I believe we can build a future that upholds the values of faith, liberty, community, and life - a future where all Americans are free to pursue their ideas, goals, and faith. This won't be possible without your involvement. I've created a simple pledge; a way to align us all around a set of shared beliefs. We cannot bring about this necessary change without you. By signing this pledge, you are committing to uphold the principles our nation was founded on and teach them to the next generations. Just one person can make a difference, and it can start with you. This is not a passive petition; it's an active pledge to uphold the common sense values that shaped our great nation. Sign the Common Sense Pledge today using this secure link: Together, we can shape a future that respects our shared history, protects our hard-earned freedoms, and prioritizes common sense. Your involvement is critical - are you ready to take action? Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81643214/463067459/-866719404?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240325_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNTYyZDMzMC1kOWVhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jEVOKl81YQMgPeePxUSvU4q-IHzyh-ym9ROcQyaQmrk=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81643215/463067460/-866719404?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240325_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNTYyZDMzMC1kOWVhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jEVOKl81YQMgPeePxUSvU4q-IHzyh-ym9ROcQyaQmrk=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the shadow of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx. = My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family. Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families. You see, the New York City government shoveled over $100 million in government aid to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street. But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families. When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it. I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress. , the last few days have been big for our campaign. **Late last week,** our first batch of yard signs arrived. body:

Hi Derek —
It’s Alexander Vindman.

I hope you can give me just a quick minute to explain why I’m reaching out
today, and why I’m humbly asking you to [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=mar2024_abs_em_vindman.Xi3A7i&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240325_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6074%2E5257348%2EP9e-xM ]make a split contribution to my
twin brother Eugene’s campaign for Congress and Adam Schiff’s for U.S.
Senate.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em_vindman.ab3-8C&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240325_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=6074%2E5257348%2EP9e-xM ]CONTRIBUTE NOW

More than four years ago now, my brother Eugene and I made the fateful
decision to do our patriotic duty and stand up to Donald Trump at the risk
of our decades-long military careers.

We reported his corrupt phone call with Ukraine — our actions eventually
led to his impeachment, and Trump retaliated by firing us from our posts.

Now Eugene is running for Congress in Virginia where he will work with
Adam and continue the fight to defend our democracy and the Constitution

Before I made the decision to run for Senate, I wanted to make sure that the constituents I had represented for more than twenty years would be well served by whoever might follow me.
I wanted to know that my replacement would be someone with both the experience and commitment to our shared values, and who would go to Washington to really get things done.
**I’m proud to say that we have that person: Laura Friedman. I’m even prouder to announce my endorsement of her campaign to succeed me in CA-30.**
I have known and worked with Laura for many years, and know her to be someone with incredible knowledge, talent and experience. She understands our community well and fights for it every day.
I knew that whoever ended up being our nominee would come to Congress at a very challenging time in our history. There’s so much work to be done -- to protect democracy, strengthen our economy, defend reproductive rights, combat climate change and more.
The good news is that Laura has been an exceptional, progressive legislator in the State Assembly. She has a proven track record of authoring and passing bills that benefit our community -- often despite tough odds. I know we can all count on her to continue her good work tackling the real challenges facing California and the country.

| | Two years ago, I first introduced a bill to ban legacy admissions at colleges, and it's great to see folks starting to take action on this issue. Earlier this month, Virginia announced that they will ban legacy admissions at all its public universities, joining Colorado as the only other state to ban this unfair practice. Here's why this is good news for everyday Americans, and why every college across the country should do it. Legacy preferences blatantly favor the well-connected over other deserving students. That's unacceptable. **We need to end legacy admissions nationwide, and my Fair College Admissions for Students Act would ban alumni and donor preferences to give all students a fair chance in the admissions process.** I introduced the _Fair College Admissions for Students Act_ following last year's U.S. Supreme Court decision overturning race-conscious college admissions decisions. Legacy admissions overwhelmingly benefit affluent, mostly white students at a time when access to higher education for students of color is under attack. Make no mistake: affirmative action is still alive and well for children of alumni and major donors, and your tax dollars shouldn't be funding it. As the first in my blue-collar family to go to college, I understand the struggles facing students whose families have never been through the process and don't have the money for expensive test prep, summer enrichment programs, or advisors to help them craft the perfect essay. Education is supposed to be the great equalizer, but it won't be as long as admissions offices favor the children of alumni and major donors and perpetuate racial and social disparities in the process. I applaud Virginia for taking steps to ban legacy admissions at all its public universities because getting into college should never hinge on how connected your family is. clean_body: Earlier this month, Virginia announced that they will ban legacy admissions at all its public universities, joining Colorado as the only other state to ban this unfair practice. | | | | Two years ago, I first introduced a bill to ban legacy admissions at colleges, and it's great to see folks starting to take action on this issue. Earlier this month, Virginia announced that they will ban legacy admissions at all its public universities, joining Colorado as the only other state to ban this unfair practice. Here's why this is good news for everyday Americans, and why every college across the country should do it. Legacy preferences blatantly favor the well-connected over other deserving students. That's unacceptable. We need to end legacy admissions nationwide, and my Fair College Admissions for Students Act would ban alumni and donor preferences to give all students a fair chance in the admissions process. I introduced the Fair College Admissions for Students Act following last year's U.S. Supreme Court decision overturning race-conscious college admissions decisions. Legacy admissions overwhelmingly benefit affluent, mostly white students at a time when access to higher education for students of color is under attack. Make no mistake: affirmative action is still alive and well for children of alumni and major donors, and your tax dollars shouldn't be funding it. As the first in my blue-collar family to go to college, I understand the struggles facing students whose families have never been through the process and don't have the money for expensive test prep, summer enrichment programs, or advisors to help them craft the perfect essay. Education is supposed to be the great equalizer, but it won't be as long as admissions offices favor the children of alumni and major donors and perpetuate racial and social disparities in the process. I applaud Virginia for taking steps to ban legacy admissions at all its public universities because getting into college should never hinge on how connected your family is. That's why I wrote a bill to ban legacy preferences, and I hope you'll join me in urging other states to follow suit as we work in Congress to pass the Fair College Admissions for Students Act and make college more accessible and equitable . Onward! [](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDYsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYXNlbmF0ZWRlbW9jcmF0cy5vcmcvczQ2LyIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDAzMjUuOTIzNDc3NTEifQ.26SWdqd3xIbdVj4Q9frlsQYh9KURFPe_l54V06ba7Tw/s/2950175210/br/239549920565-l)
---
Senator Breaux, who sadly passed away last week, was a champion for families, public education, and access to healthcare— especially for the Black community.

I am a better legislator for having served alongside her. She was bold. She was fierce. She was unafraid to ask questions, to challenge the status quo.

Senator Breaux was my dear friend and mentor and I will feel her absence deeply and think of her often. My heart is with her mom, former Senator Billie Breaux, her extended family, and all of the Hoosiers mourning this great loss. May Jean’s memory be a blessing.

body:
#
**First,** last month we emailed you on how AIPAC — the wealthy, conservative, pro-Israel PAC — is recruiting Democratic primary challengers to defeat Alexandria and five other Squad members this election year.
**Then** , we just found out that since October, AIPAC has spent more than $1 million on Facebook ads, funneling money from GOP megadonors to exclusively target progressive candidates.
This is the same group that provided unconditional support to the 109 Republicans who refused to certify the 2020 presidential election.
**Now Alexandria needs you to have her back.**
[Will you contribute $5 today to ensure our campaign has the resources to fight back against AIPAC’s massive spending against our progressive movement?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240325.Z2YY4G&refcode=em20240325-6070-P_FND_MMF_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6070%2E2526796%2EhTePYE)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240325.Z2YY4G&refcode=em20240325-6070-P_FND_MMF_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=6070%2E2526796%2EhTePYE)**
AIPAC doesn’t like that Alexandria supports a bilateral ceasefire in Gaza — even though that’s an opinion shared by 61% of Americans, regardless of political party.1
AIPAC and its super PAC, United Democracy Project, spent $30 million in 2022’s Democratic primaries, entirely focused against just 8 progressive candidates, many of whom were candidates of color. They helped defeat 6 of them.
AIPAC is seriously scaling up to spread their regressive and right-wing agenda. When a right-wing group attacks Alexandria and our entire progressive movement, it’s imperative that we have the resources to fight back.
[Will you contribute $5 right now to help us defeat AIPAC? AIPAC is going after Alexandria this election year and we need to be prepared.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240325.Z2YY4G&refcode=em20240325-6070-P_FND_MMF_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6070%2E2526796%2EhTePYE)
In solidarity,
Team AOC

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Does the next generation share your beliefs?
body:
Shifts in our society threaten to dilute our nation's character

|
---
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=00c984667a2c424f8253b421729b7446&_e=mYMNNnYJWRQRL2HfVt1lUYT9EqhQEWlJlMVfPBldOpvJ-7YIGtwGma0vU_gTkAACA3AP3vWE4RxVQnaA_bgWkmcK5UgtkDPrBSIGmxlp9sRsDe5uzwLc2dTnAHP5Q4prKEe9j9Tpr6JfkL9miwhsJtvapMa2Xd61-Wbs0E0yDWQhT3cMlQAf4zaiDicSvtu6vpLd_-rWE6dXms3ihBTYPLgejrH9SYtkzu2WoTBfcQMiOxNcFkI_a7urOGuL0Zw0dzq4v45rwwKj01cHNmaT8zUCR1nt0SuraRlWrecGoNSXS6kuZiFlxGYk6jnpp3xFwC9ltSmhon_X6GOKjkSaJBSVQ-Y6jnhJW3tKABxYXOqirz_z2CKoakLKrYHQUUK46UxAuUr1TxjbsiAZATXBJfy75NlwfvDOei9Va8VPl9M%3D)
---
| Dear Fellow Patriot,

I believe that America stands at a crossroads. Our individual freedoms, the nation's respect for the Constitution, and the legacy of our Founders are all enduring relentless assaults. Shifts in our society threaten to dilute our nation's character while biased media and divisive politics amplify it greater than ever.

The people that this impacts the most are not you and I-_It is our future generation._ Our children and grandchildren are being taught that that is their skin that defines them, not the content of their character. They are being taught that our nation's history is something to be ashamed of. [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=00c984667a2c424f8253b421729b7446&_e=mYMNNnYJWRQRL2HfVt1lUYT9EqhQEWlJlMVfPBldOpvJ-7YIGtwGma0vU_gTkAACA3AP3vWE4RxVQnaA_bgWkmcK5UgtkDPrBSIGmxlp9sRsDe5uzwLc2dTnAHP5Q4prKEe9j9Tpr6JfkL9miwhsJtvapMa2Xd61-Wbs0E0yDWQhT3cMlQAf4zaiDicSvtu6vpLd_-rWE6dXms3ihBTYPLgejrH9SYtkzu2WoTBfcQMiOxNcFkI_a7urOGuL0Zw0dzq4v45rwwKj01cHNmaT8wikaG3GIjjIm0D-ZMm-6dV38b1q9RGeYNbeofObkltw_lqjDhHXuHSZmF2JsL0WhhRAzZLXWPi5tx_pk8lfH1VSjoZH5Q8-ybO0qMVlVlt0khqjRwSZUrVuky8mDoNY69GWLDh-_OSgmCW_w5maYyM%3D) Candidly, it just doesn't make any sense.

But, I believe we can change this. I believe we can build a future that upholds the values of faith, liberty, community, and life - a future where all Americans are free to pursue their ideas, goals, and faith.

This won't be possible without your involvement. I've created a simple pledge; a way to align us all around a set of shared beliefs. [I want to invite you to take the Common Sense Pledge.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=00c984667a2c424f8253b421729b7446&_e=mYMNNnYJWRQRL2HfVt1lUYT9EqhQEWlJlMVfPBldOpvJ-7YIGtwGma0vU_gTkAACA3AP3vWE4RxVQnaA_bgWkmcK5UgtkDPrBSIGmxlp9sRsDe5uzwLc2dTnAHP5Q4prKEe9j9Tpr6JfkL9miwhsJtvapMa2Xd61-Wbs0E0yDWQhT3cMlQAf4zaiDicSvtu6vpLd_-rWE6dXms3ihBTYPLgejrH9SYtkzu2WoTBfcQMHywdhgj7SBUJSvEJX6cpcCazVX2eANcrZfB1y2_FCCCkUuWYdtI9_3O4hwmYXgWJ-QCYKYj7wpAnjuLv6aWz9NcjFabgnQdK-FGTyK6bl3gC_ZtSgNBNCj9OT1kXQfraeP08YDURXmvzLiacx_zI0vnC-J8MuTylWmIw-uWcUGw%3D%3D)

We cannot bring about this necessary change without you. By signing this pledge, you are committing to uphold the principles our nation was founded on and teach them to the next generations. **Just one person can make a difference, and it can start with you.**

This is not a passive petition; it's an active pledge to uphold the common sense values that shaped our great nation.

Sign the Common Sense Pledge today using this secure link: [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/common-sense-pledge/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=00c984667a2c424f8253b421729b7446&_e=mYMNNnYJWRQRL2HfVt1lUYT9EqhQEWlJlMVfPBldOpvJ-7YIGtwGma0vU_gTkAACA3AP3vWE4RxVQnaA_bgWkmcK5UgtkDPrBSIGmxlp9sRsDe5uzwLc2dTnAHP5Q4prKEe9j9Tpr6JfkL9miwhsJtvapMa2Xd61-Wbs0E0yDWQhT3cMlQAf4zaiDicSvtu6vpLd_-rWE6dXms3ihBTYPLgejrH9SYtkzu2WoTBfcQMHywdhgj7SBUJSvEJX6cpcScX2HIPdyW74boMBgPE4k-degaWpL79QeSukdsSZU_ckf3r1Nz1auiGx1GF8X17eJnbjtP5bTNXvmgipWI_Lk538T_i1U5g7IGa6V_PmQ-cNLhBEKv-13Om6wz_R9eHK78J46d05qEHGqkQJZY-vmg%3D%3D)

Together, we can shape a future that respects our shared history, protects our hard-earned freedoms, and prioritizes common sense. Your involvement is critical - are you ready to take action?

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman

Team, My organization, Leaders We Deserve, is working with a lot of inspiring young candidates this election cycle, but today I want to tell you about one race in particular that I’m excited about: **Sarah McBride** , our newly endorsed candidate for Delaware’s at-large seat in the U.S. Congress. **[But first, can you donate $5 to Sarah’s historic campaign for Congress? Together, we can elect a proven progressive leader to fight for our future.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81650880/463083923/-1678796816?refcode=em20240325&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjI0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZWIwMWFiYy1lM2VhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DyUpePH_-DEA9YBiDX_a74MnxslLVRQyVGksuxFVYpc=)** | [Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81650881/463083925/1505353391?refcode=em20240325&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjI0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZWIwMWFiYy1lM2VhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DyUpePH_-DEA9YBiDX_a74MnxslLVRQyVGksuxFVYpc=)
---
Sarah is no stranger to making history: In 2016, she became the first openly transgender person to address a national party convention. When she was elected to the Delaware State Senate in 2020, she became the first transgender state senator in the entire country. **And when we help her win in November, she’ll break new ground as the first ever transgender member of Congress.**
During her time as a state legislator, Sarah has already earned an impressive record of victories and real results for the people of her district, including passing paid family and medical leave, an assault weapons ban and other significant gun safety reform, and a number of bills protecting reproductive freedom in Delaware.
And just last week, she announced new legislation to secure the largest ongoing investment in Delaware’s Medicaid program since the Affordable Care Act.

body:
After 8 years of working for President Trump, it is an honor to have his endorsement. | | | | | [](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=a5e1d4c2aa&e=12b2add68a)
---
Friend,
In 2024, Georgia will determine the trajectory of our nation for decades to come - and while we’ve heard it countless times before, it has never rung more true: **this November will be the most important election of our lifetimes.**
Joe Biden and Democrats in Congress have spent the last three years systematically undermining America’s prosperity at home and strength abroad. Our most sacred values and fundamental freedoms are under relentless attack - and I refuse to sit by as the Biden regime tries to silence President Trump and the millions of Americans who stand with him.
_**Peter, my name is Brian Jack.**_
I have spent the last decade fighting tooth and nail for President Trump and his America First agenda. In 2016, I helped Donald Trump defeat establishment politicians in both parties, **and it was the honor of my life to serve his Administration as Political Director and Senior Advisor to the President.**
Under his strong leadership, our economy soared, our border was secure, the world was at peace, and the silent majority of forgotten Americans finally had a champion. Georgia is ready to send Donald Trump back to the White House in November, along with a conservative House Majority to help make America great once again.
**That is why earlier this month, I announced my candidacy to represent Georgia’s Third Congressional District, with the complete and total endorsement of President Donald J. Trump.**

[](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=30189b0734&e=12b2add68a)
| [JOIN THE TRUMP-JACK TEAM](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=c848f4345a&e=12b2add68a)
---
**President Trump needs trusted allies in Congress to put into action our America First agenda** \- ending Biden’s border invasion and finishing the wall, reviving our economy and draining the D.C. swamp that threatens our freedoms and our way of life.
As you know, Democrats and liberal special interests have spent _hundreds of millions of dollars_ in the past few years to transform our beloved Georgia into a bastion of failed progressive policies. **2024 will be no different** \- and to combat attacks from the radical left and expand our conservative House majority, I am humbly asking for your support.
[_**Peter, will you join President Trump and support our campaign for Congress by rushing a grassroots donation today?**_](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=3461db6639&e=12b2add68a)[_****_](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=5202f27b79&e=12b2add68a)
| [DONATE TODAY](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=902fd231b8&e=12b2add68a)
---
_Georgia has always been home._
Our shared Georgia values - reverence for God, Country, and the blessings of liberty we’ve inherited from our founders - have guided my service. As a 6th-generation Georgian, I took those values to Washington when advising President Trump - and will bring them to Congress, where they’re needed now more than ever.
_Peter, it’s time for patriotic citizens to stand tall and save the America we grew up in._
With so much at stake, we cannot allow Democrats - or any weak-willed Republicans - to gain ground in Georgia. [**Please chip in $10, $20, or anything you can** _**right now**_**to help us lay the foundation for a winning campaign.**](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=e9a8ea8694&e=12b2add68a)
| [PITCH IN $10](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=9461557fbd&e=12b2add68a)
---
| [PITCH IN $20.24](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=1f89c575ca&e=12b2add68a)
---
| [PITCH IN $47](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=1d3597a257&e=12b2add68a)
---
| [CONTRIBUTE ANY AMOUNT](https://brianjack.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2ac8d6090efa273e0be469f80&id=aa957163bd&e=12b2add68a)
---
_Thank you for taking this stand with me, Peter._
In Liberty,

subject: 185 Democrats voted to worsen famine and greenlight genocide
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

On Friday, the U.S. House passed a $1.2 trillion spending bill that bans
UNRWA funding for an entire year as experts warn famine is imminent for
more than 1 million people in Gaza while Israel continues to block aid
trucks. President Biden has since signed it into law.

A vote for this bill was a pro-famine vote. Instead of reinstating U.S.
funding to Palestinians’ largest source of aid, members on both sides of
the aisle voted to withhold desperately needed food and water from
starving children and families. They chose to make this humanitarian
catastrophe worse.

Not only that, but this bill included another $3.8 BILLION for the Israeli
military with zero conditions to stop them from committing human rights
abuses. 185 Democrats voted to give Netanyahu a green light for genocide.

But do you know who stood on the right side of history and voted against
this horrific bill? The same members who AIPAC & DMFI are targeting for
defending Palestinian human rights — members like Jamaal Bowman, Cori
Bush, Summer Lee, AOC, Ilhan Omar, Ayanna Pressley, and Rashida Tlaib.

This is a key reminder of why our movement matters, and why right-wing
dark money groups are trying to unseat our progressive champions in
Congress this year: they are some of the only leaders in Washington with
the moral courage to oppose our government enabling genocide and mass
starvation.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240325.L2vVAD&refcode=em20240325-33986&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=33986%2E1203867%2EJLRx5G ]Please, help us take on our far-right opponents like AIPAC and re-elect
our Justice Democrats incumbents to Congress this year by pitching in
$5 or more to fuel our work and keep up the fight for human
rights.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240325.L2vVAD&refcode=em20240325-33986&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1020&akid=33986%2E1203867%2EJLRx5G ]Contribute $5

These progressive leaders made it to Congress through grassroots support
from people like you — now we need to build as much people-power as
possible to keep them there fighting for our communities and the change we
deserve.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director
