Happy **Women’s History Month!**

Every March, we take the time to recognize and celebrate the trailblazing women across the globe who have made our world a better and more equitable place.

Honoring this month is especially important to us here in California as Women’s History Month began when the _Education Task Force of the Sonoma County Commission on the Status of Women_ created Women’s History Week in 1978.

Today, support for this California initiative of celebrating women's contributions continues to grow across the United States and around the world.

We know, however, that commemorative measures alone are not enough. That’s why I support the Equal Rights Amendment and will stand with you against all forms of inequality.

**_Women’s history matters this month and every month._**

Please join me in championing inclusion in our democracy and shaping the future of our country together. Our fight for equal rights marches on.

– Jimmy

It took years of organizing, activism, and holding Republicans accountable to make this possible.

Friends, It’s hard to believe that 13 years ago, almost to the day, I was at the Wisconsin Capitol protesting Governor Scott Walker’s heinous attacks on our unions and our democracy. **I like to say that I have Scott Walker to thank for lighting a fire in my soul — because without him, I wouldn’t be writing to you today as Legal Counsel for the NDRC.** Looking back today, in the wake of the recent fair-maps victory in my home state, we need to recognize that this took years of organizing, activism, and holding Republicans accountable to make possible. **Let’s take it from the top:**
* In 2011, newly-elected Governor Scott Walker wasted no time focusing on manipulating our legislative maps.
* He and his extreme allies in the state legislature quickly got to work, changing the rules of the state Supreme Court to undermine the state’s longstanding chief justice, gutting the state’s nonpartisan elections board, and enacting a horrifying gerrymander, which guaranteed them an unearned lock on power for a decade.
* When the NDRC was founded in 2017, we began to build an infrastructure for activism and organizing which put a spotlight on just how badly Republicans were bending the rules.
* In 2018, Governor Tony Evers won and promised to be a fair maps champion. But the GOP-controlled legislature immediately stripped away many of his powers.
* In that critical moment, we didn’t back down. We took our organizing to another level.
* All that work culminated last year in the election of Judge Janet Protasiewicz to the Wisconsin Supreme Court, breaking the long-held conservative stranglehold on the court.
* By 2024, Republicans knew their days of running rampant with maps were over. The legislature passed Governor Evers’ fair maps ahead of this year’s elections.

For the first time since I became eligible to vote, Wisconsin’s maps are finally fair. While the pundits will try and point to one person, one election, or one court decision, the truth is none of this would've been possible without this movement. Thank you for being with us every step of the way. **But our work is far from over. We need to build on the momentum from this victory and bring it to other states in need of reform. ** [**What we’ve done in Wisconsin is proof that the investments you make in this work pay off — can we count on you to make a grassroots donation of $30 today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81654786/463093468/2035465204?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_marfun_email_20240325-NDRC-Red-WisconsinTimeline_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240325-NDRC-Red-WisconsinTimeline_&utm_campaign=marfun&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ4ZGZiZjA2LWVjZWEtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=lW0K3m1-Rportr_2MzxZClGeoaZPbjYuJhhz0CJz_e0=) | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

clean_body: It took years of organizing, activism, and holding Republicans accountable to make this possible. | Friends, It’s hard to believe that 13 years ago, almost to the day, I was at the Wisconsin Capitol protesting Governor Scott Walker’s heinous attacks on our unions and our democracy. I like to say that I have Scott Walker to thank for lighting a fire in my soul — because without him, I wouldn’t be writing to you today as Legal Counsel for the NDRC. Looking back today, in the wake of the recent fair-maps victory in my home state, we need to recognize that this took years of organizing, activism, and holding Republicans accountable to make possible. Let’s take it from the top: In 2011, newly-elected Governor Scott Walker wasted no time focusing on manipulating our legislative maps. He and his extreme allies in the state legislature quickly got to work, changing the rules of the state Supreme Court to undermine the state’s longstanding chief justice, gutting the state’s nonpartisan elections board, and enacting a horrifying gerrymander, which guaranteed them an unearned lock on power for a decade. When the NDRC was founded in 2017, we began to build an infrastructure for activism and organizing which put a spotlight on just how badly Republicans were bending the rules. In 2018, Governor Tony Evers won and promised to be a fair maps champion. But the GOP-controlled legislature immediately stripped away many of his powers. In that critical moment, we didn’t back down. We took our organizing to another level. All that work culminated last year in the election of Judge Janet Protasiewicz to the Wisconsin Supreme Court, breaking the long-held conservative stranglehold on the court. By 2024, Republicans knew their days of running rampant with maps were over. The legislature passed Governor Evers’ fair maps ahead of this year’s elections. For the first time since I became eligible to vote, Wisconsin’s maps are finally fair. While the pundits will try and point to one person, one election, or one court decision, the truth is none of this would've been possible without this movement. Thank you for being with us every step of the way. But our work is far from over. We need to build on the momentum from this victory and bring it to other states in need of reform. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Our work doesn’t always make headlines, but it does make a difference. You’re powering the small but critical steps we’re making towards fair maps every day, and for that, this Wisconsinite is grateful. Thank you, Jacob Carrel = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. Our victories have been made possible by our strong community of grassroots supporters. = If you want to receive periodic updates from the NDRC on our fight for fair maps, text MAPS to 36787. name: Jesse James Mullen
subject: Around the world and back again - Montana anyway
body:
Team Jesse James wrapped the Planes, Trains, and Automobiles tour | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mullenformontana/around-the-world-and-back-again-montana-anyway?e=805e709ff8)
---
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=ee37da6924&e=805e709ff8)
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=24c6fed540&e=805e709ff8)
Hey team, it’s Jesse James,
We made it, and what a trip!
Using Montana’s affordable transportation options, I met with voters across Montana’s Hi-Line and from the North Dakota border to near Wyoming and Idaho.
And I did it for about $200.
Do you know what $200 buys most campaigns? About 45 minutes with a DC consultant. But we’re not most campaigns. A [SMALL DONATION](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=332077d232&e=805e709ff8), makes a [BIG DIFFERENCE!](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=ae5259f68e&e=805e709ff8)
| [DONATE](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=1f01807157&e=805e709ff8)
---
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=87a232727c&e=805e709ff8)
Here’s what our campaign did with $200:
[We made the radio!](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=c4c3af0411&e=805e709ff8) [We made the front page of the newspaper](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=8f3fb77dce&e=805e709ff8), [twice](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=c984a12ae8&e=805e709ff8)! We met with Montana’s premiere [aging advocacy organization!](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=046ad83868&e=805e709ff8) We highlighted [federally subsidized transport](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=821137ed18&e=805e709ff8), which is integral to life in Eastern Montana! [And](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=25b4e98837&e=805e709ff8) [so](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=f396a706f8&e=805e709ff8) [much](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=3e7b878291&e=805e709ff8) [more](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=b43bf14b88&e=805e709ff8)!
I don’t fearmonger in these emails like other candidates for public office. But I won’t lie; funding is tight for a Secretary of State race. You know what’s at stake: the integrity of Montana’s elections.
We will win this with your help! I know you have to pick and choose which campaigns are worth supporting financially and through volunteer time. I guarantee you, there’s not a candidate in Montana working harder for you than me.
Please help set up a [recurring donation today](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=e90befc61f&e=805e709ff8).
Thank you,Jesse James Mullen

Friend,
It's Vicente Gonzalez, and I proudly represent South Texas in Congress. You may have seen the headlines about the millions of dollars spent against me from far-right MAGA extremists.
But let me tell you, I'm no stranger to a tough election. I've been an underdog before, and I want to tell you the whole story. But if you only have a moment, I need to ask you to support our campaign for this MUST-WIN seat for Democrats to take back Congress in what was Texas' CLOSEST congressional election last time >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240325_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
Let me take a step back.
I was born to a humble military family in Texas. It was not the kind of upbringing where we had everything handed to us, and I wouldn't have it any other way.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240325_em_fr_b1_VG_initial [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240325_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
Following my mother's guidance "Hace más el que quiere que el que puede"— he who has the desire to do more, does more — I put in the work to get my GED, go to community college, and earn a law degree to be able to give back to my community.
I started a law practice so I could take on the wealthy and powerful that sought out to hurt working families, all too often families that looked a lot like mine. I took on big insurance companies to ensure residents were taken care of after disasters and won back millions of dollars for our local schools.
As a lifelong Democrat, I ran for Congress to ensure we supported our veterans, provided access to quality healthcare, and kept our communities safe.
I'm no stranger to tough campaigns and close elections . I've had congressional campaigns where my margin of victory was less than 7,000 votes. Last election, our district was the CLOSEST congressional race in Texas, and we are confirmed for a re-match this year. Friend, can you chip in today and help us meet our End of Quarter Fundraising Goal and defeat my MAGA extremist opponent? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240325_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
WIN THIS RACE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240325_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
Humbly,
Vicente Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240325_em_fr_b1_VG_initial [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240325_em_fr_b1_VG_initial]
While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.

name: Patrick Denny
subject: Behind the scenes
body:
Friend,

Can you believe that there’s less than one month left in Maryland’s legislative session? As part of Team Wes, I can’t wait for us to finish strong.
Working with Wes is an honor and a privilege — especially during session when we get to see him in action, achieving real progress for the people of Maryland.

When Wes swore his oath and took the governor’s office, he did so with a promise to be the best public servant he possibly could. I might be biased, but I think he’s accomplishing it.

We can all see the laws passed and new economic growth under this administration. But folks may not see just how much work happens behind the scenes. Wes puts in the long hours and long nights because he cares about the success of all Marylanders. Wes and Aruna ran on a vision of a bright future of our state, and now, we’re bringing it to life.

Together, the Governor and Lieutenant Governor Aruna Miller set an agenda for the 2024 legislative session and are driving it home to make Maryland safer, more affordable, and more competitive.

We’re so grateful for your support along the way.

Patrick

Friends,
Bob Lorinser here; Candidate for US Congress in Northern Michigan and the UP.
You and I both know it's time for politicians to stop using worthless rhetoric. For example, "We need _ 'access'_ to medical care." Everyone knows that. How are we going to get it done? (Pro-tip: Medicare for All)
Or, "We need to rein in worthless spending." Sure, Rep. Bergman. You find the specific programs you'd consider 'worthless' and explain to the public how they're causing a deficit.
So much of what comes out of a typical politician's mouth is just fluff; words are meaningless unless they have action, reason, or data behind them.
**What I'm interested in is how we are going to get.things.done.**
**We need to start providing solutions.**
That's why I am running for Congress — to amplify the voices of the people and offer tangible solutions and good legislation. I will work tirelessly on the issues that affect us all, like healthcare, childcare, public education, housing, labor reform, livable wages, climate change, etc.
But, I can't do it alone. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81657019/463101227/1879636069?refcode=email_032524_Broke-the-mold&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYjBkZTkyMC1mNWVhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pB-P814u5W-eiji-SfZORKq-kWwAw9i4HEgPCoW1RBo=) When I flipped a Republican-held congressional seat, it’s fair to say I broke the mold in a few ways. Not just because I became Kansas’s _only_ federally elected Democratic representative. But also because, I’m an LGBTQ+ Native American woman and former MMA fighter who was raised by a single Army mom and worked multiple jobs to pay my own way through school. So, no, it’s fair to say I didn’t come to Washington with your typical congressional resume. [_**If you think a voice like mine belongs in Congress, I’d love to have your support in this campaign, because we’re facing one tough fight in my race for re-election — and, candidly, the House majority hangs in the balance.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81657020/463101228/1393271644?refcode=email_032524_Broke-the-mold&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYjBkZTkyMC1mNWVhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pB-P814u5W-eiji-SfZORKq-kWwAw9i4HEgPCoW1RBo=) | | [Donate →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81657021/463101229/1393271644?refcode=email_032524_Broke-the-mold&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYjBkZTkyMC1mNWVhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pB-P814u5W-eiji-SfZORKq-kWwAw9i4HEgPCoW1RBo=)

But I also want to be clear about this: I’m not asking for your support — or anyone else’s — just because of who I am or the road I took to get to Congress.
**I’m asking for your support because of my record: what I’ve used my voice to fight for in Washington, and what I’ll keep fighting for if I have the privilege of continuing to serve.**
My philosophy has always been that we need leaders who are grown-up enough to put partisanship aside and get things done.
That’s why I’m proud to have helped create over 20,000 clean-energy jobs right here in KS-03. It’s why I’m proud to have saved seniors money on insulin and passed a bipartisan infrastructure law that’s kick-started construction on over 300 vital projects across Kansas.
**And it’s why I’m so determined to restore abortion rights, defend our democracy, and make our economy work better for Americans who are struggling today — because together, we’ve tackled tough problems and weathered tough times before. And I know that we can keep making real progress if we stay in the fight.**

Pennsylvania is my home, and it always will be.

It’s where I was born, where I grew up, and where Terese and I raised our family.

It’s also where I started a career in public service that has always been about fighting for Pennsylvania families.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81657455/463102823/107443937?refcode=em24_240325_pablue_fndt_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240325_pablue_fndt_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=18326&refcode2=7d55d0c9-f7ea-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDU1ZDBjOS1mN2VhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3xDyArd3kmN6W63aWY6BBXsWO1RHsA4g1MbEyMPyMqs=)
I chose to make Scranton my home because of the people. I enjoy that in Scranton, saying “hello” or “how’s it going?” in the grocery store checkout line always leads to an engaging conversation. Neighbors don’t just say “hello” back and go on with their day. They’re going to tell you about what they’re buying and about their family — and they’ll ask you about what you’re buying and about your family, too.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81657456/463102824/107443937?refcode=em24_240325_pablue_fndt_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240325_pablue_fndt_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=18326&refcode2=7d55d0c9-f7ea-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDU1ZDBjOS1mN2VhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3xDyArd3kmN6W63aWY6BBXsWO1RHsA4g1MbEyMPyMqs=)
Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m proud of the fights we’ve won together.

I’m running for re-election because there are fights we still must win together – like the fight for voting rights, women’s rights, and workers’ rights; the fight to lower costs for working families; and the fight for our children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81657457/463102825/107443937?refcode=em24_240325_pablue_fndt_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240325_pablue_fndt_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=18326&refcode2=7d55d0c9-f7ea-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDU1ZDBjOS1mN2VhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3xDyArd3kmN6W63aWY6BBXsWO1RHsA4g1MbEyMPyMqs=)
The reality is, this is going to be my toughest race yet. My opponent is worth hundreds of millions of dollars and will be another “yes” vote for big corporations and the ultra-wealthy like him in the Senate. **That’s why Wall Street billionaires are trying so hard to defeat me and flip this seat.**

This is going to be one of the most expensive Senate races in the Nation, and we have to be ready to fight back against millions upon millions in outside spending if we’re going to win.

[**With the Senate majority hinging on this seat, your support is more important than ever. So what do you say? Will you split a donation between my campaign and Matt Cartwright's to keep PA and the Senate blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81657458/463102826/107443937?refcode=em24_240325_pablue_fndt_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240325_pablue_fndt_gq_act___bc_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=18326&refcode2=7d55d0c9-f7ea-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDU1ZDBjOS1mN2VhLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3xDyArd3kmN6W63aWY6BBXsWO1RHsA4g1MbEyMPyMqs=)

I enjoy that in Scranton, saying “hello” or “how’s it going?” in the grocery store checkout line always leads to an engaging conversation. Neighbors don’t just say “hello” back and go on with their day. They’re going to tell you about what they’re buying and about their family — and they’ll ask you about what you’re buying and about your family, too. = Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m proud of the fights we’ve won together. I’m running for re-election because there are fights we still must win together – like the fight for voting rights, women’s rights, and workers’ rights; the fight to lower costs for working families; and the fight for our children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities. = The reality is, this is going to be my toughest race yet. My opponent is worth hundreds of millions of dollars and will be another “yes” vote for big corporations and the ultra-wealthy like him in the Senate. That’s why Wall Street billionaires are trying so hard to defeat me and flip this seat. This is going to be one of the most expensive Senate races in the Nation, and we have to be ready to fight back against millions upon millions in outside spending if we’re going to win. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split evenly between Matt Cartwright and Bob Casey: = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- With gratitude, Bob Casey = In 2022, Matt Cartwright was one of only 5 Democrats to win a House race in a district that Donald Trump carried in 2020. Friend, This weekend, President Biden signed a bill into law that most members of Congress voted for, which sent billions of American tax dollars to the Pentagon, ICE, and Israel’s military. This just-passed legislation also ended U.S. funding for the UN agency known as UNRWA, which is the primary provider and distributor of aid within Gaza—including food, water, healthcare, and emergency shelter. **More than 1 million people in Gaza are facing imminent famine. Children, who are especially vulnerable, have begun starving to death. And our government is making it worse, blocking starving Palestinians from receiving needed assistance.** I voted no on the bill, which also prohibits funding for UN investigations into the Israeli government’s human rights violations. Human rights experts agree that Israel’s government is violating international humanitarian law in numerous ways, including by using starvation as a weapon of war—intentionally targeting Gaza’s food and water infrastructure, bombing aid centers, blocking aid trucks carrying key supplies and baby formula, and massacring starving Palestinians seeking food. Because of these horrors, the United Nations has been pushing for a ceasefire. The U.S. has blocked ceasefire votes in the UN Security Council, until today. Today the United Nations voted 14-0 in favor of a temporary ceasefire through the remainder of Ramadan. As the top funder and weapons provider for Israel’s military, the U.S. government should use our leverage to stop the violence and force Israel’s government to allow in sufficient aid.
Instead, the U.S. government is deepening our complicity in the genocide of the Palestinian people.
Already, thousands of U.S.-made bombs have forcibly displaced millions of Palestinians in Gaza. Nearly everyone in Gaza has had to move multiple times in the past five months, and most have sought shelter in UNRWA facilities.****
As the best-equipped group to provide life-saving humanitarian aid on a massive scale in Gaza, UNRWA needs funding now more than ever.

Because of these horrors, the United Nations has been pushing for a ceasefire. The U.S. has blocked ceasefire votes in the UN Security Council, until today. Today the United Nations voted 14-0 in favor of a temporary ceasefire through the remainder of Ramadan. The U.S. abstained from the vote, allowing the vote to proceed. While we need a lasting, permanent ceasefire, this is an important first step that shows that our pressure on President Biden is working. Now’s the time to keep pushing! | The world’s highest court has demanded action to stop this unfolding genocide. As the top funder and weapons provider for Israel’s military, the U.S. government should use our leverage to stop the violence and force Israel’s government to allow in sufficient aid. Instead, the U.S. government is deepening our complicity in the genocide of the Palestinian people. Already, thousands of U.S.-made bombs have forcibly displaced millions of Palestinians in Gaza. Nearly everyone in Gaza has had to move multiple times in the past five months, and most have sought shelter in UNRWA facilities.** As the best-equipped group to provide life-saving humanitarian aid on a massive scale in Gaza, UNRWA needs funding now more than ever. Thank you for taking action to affirm our shared humanity. Please keep speaking up. When our government contributes to such devaluing of human life, it endangers all of us—especially people in marginalized communities. I will continue demanding our government instead invest in and expand human rights. name: Michael Greenberg
subject: One Year Ago This Week
body:
| | | | | [](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=ddfacdbb4c&e=c0a1c11fc3)
---
One year ago this week we held our Climate Defiance launch party. (If you want to skip the rest of this email and send us a birthday gift, you can do [here](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=fdd24261fa&e=c0a1c11fc3).)
Oh boy was I terrified.
Mainly, I was terrified of failure. I was worried I would embarrass myself, and no one would show up. Worried I would launch a group that would be the laughing stock of the movement.
But people came. First trickling in one by one, then lining up by the dozen.
Even Bill McKibben stopped by. More than anyone, he's the person whose writing and organizing got me started in climate advocacy over a decade ago.
[](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=7741b2ad08&e=c0a1c11fc3)
Now a year later, I can take a moment to reflect on what a wild ride it’s been.
Our first action was a blockade of the White House Correspondents Dinner. I stood literally chest-to-chest with White House Chief of Staff Ron Klain for 15 seconds as he tried to push his way into the dinner. A Secret Service SUV drove into me, trying to get me to cede the ground, but I held firm, arm-in-arm with a group of brave activists.
Shortly after, sitting in at the Harvard Club to protest the Mountain Valley Pipeline, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer had to step over my shoulder and between my legs to get through his luncheon.
We triggered [Joe Manchin](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=0aaf606037&e=c0a1c11fc3) so hard he almost punched our volunteer. We crashed the Fed Symposium in Jackson Hole, messing with the world's largest gathering of Central Bankers. We made Jerome Powell proclaim ["close the fucking door"](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=6797f467bf&e=c0a1c11fc3) on a hot mic. We took over the birthday party of former Majority Leader Steny Hoyer. We made Amy Klobuchar FLEE from her own book launch party (her book was titled "The Joy of Politics"...in case you have an industrial paper shredder you've been itching to put to good use). We disrupted the Congressional Softball Game for so long the lawmakers started doing the Cupid Shuffle to pass the time.
They don't always like our tone.
They don't always like our tactics.
But dammit, they respect us.
We have built real political power. The White House had to invite us in for a meeting, not because they enjoy our company but because we are a real political force that can no longer be ignored.
On this one year birthday, I ask you to make a commitment to yourself to do something that makes you uncomfortable. Maybe that's joining us in chasing a climate criminal out of a black-tie gala. Maybe that's risking arrest with us (more info coming within 1 month on an opportunity to do so). Maybe that's [donating](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=e3a933cf9c&e=c0a1c11fc3). At a level that's meaningful for you. At a level that hurts just the right amount.
One year after our launch party, I promise you we are just getting started. Until those in power address the climate crisis with the urgency it demands, we will be in their faces, making good trouble.
Can you make a one-year birthday gift to help keep this going? You can do so [here](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=4cb4987ced&e=c0a1c11fc3) or by clicking the button at the bottom of this email.
In defiance,Michael

clean_body: Let's keep up this momentum! | = We did it, team: I officially became the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Texas! I am so grateful to my fellow Texas voters and grassroots supporters like you for entrusting me with this honor – I will not let you down. I'm ready to outwork Ted Cruz to win this thing because the stakes of this election are too high not to. From voting rights to abortion, our freedoms are under attack. Everyday costs are still too high. Simply put: Texans cannot afford six more years of Ted Cruz. That’s why this campaign is so important. Two recent polls showed us tied with Cruz, and I know we can win this race – but I need you with me to do it. So I have to ask, team:= | = | = | = | = | = The real race begins right now, team, and it's going to be a tough fight. But don't worry – I've been an underdog my whole life. I know what it takes to beat the odds and win a tough fight. I'm a 4th generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom who sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. I never knew my dad but thanks to my community of teachers, coaches and counselors at the YMCA, who helped my mom, aunt and uncle raise me, I had the opportunity to chase my version of the American Dream. Without them, I never would've made it to the NFL, gone to law school, become a civil rights lawyer, served in the Obama Administration, or run against a 22-year GOP incumbent and won, becoming the first Democrat to ever represent TX-32 in Congress. And thanks to them, I am where I am today: the official Democratic nominee who has the chance to become Texas’ first Black Senator. The chance to finally defeat Ted Cruz and give Texans the committed leadership we deserve. With experts calling Ted Cruz the most vulnerable GOP senator in the country and two polls showing us TIED, the only thing that could hold us back is resources. It’s true that everything is bigger in Texas, and this campaign is no exception. It’s going to take the biggest grassroots movement Texas has ever seen to beat Ted Cruz. Ted Cruz already has more than $6.5 million in the bank to attack me with, so please: = | = Thank you so much for being a part of this team. Let's do this. Colin P.S. With your gift of any amount tonight, you'll become one of my very first General Election Founding Donors. His race in NY-19 was just rated one of the most competitive in the country, and a must-win for Dems to take back the House.

Hello, Mark Hamill here.

I want to tell you why I'm proudly supporting Harry Dunn to represent Maryland’s 3rd Congressional District.

Over the course of our lives, we all have moments that we think, "I'll never forget where I was that day."

_January 6 was one of those days._

And for Harry, he'll never forget where he was: defending democracy with his bare hands, fighting the violent mob at the Capitol.

In those moments, he was holding the line on our democracy – knowing that it could crumble right before his eyes.

That day, Harry was a hero. He protected Republicans and Democrats alike. He stood to protect democracy, and he's never wavered in that protection.

Since then, he’s been a fierce advocate for democracy and justice in the face of MAGA extremism. As some of those who stood behind him while he fought off insurrectionists try to deny what happened that day, Harry is speaking truth to power.
